Forget what you know about old-school industry rules. When you work at Old Navy, you’re choosing a different path. From day one, we’ve been on a mission to democratize fashion and make shopping fun again. Our teams make style accessible to everyone, creating high-quality, must-have fashion essentials for the whole family, with love, season after season.  
  
We opened our first store in 1994 in San Francisco and have been on a roll ever since. Today, customers can find fabulous fashion at affordable prices online and in one of our 1,000+ stores globally. Old Navy celebrates a workplace that’s just as diverse as our customers. Fun, fashion, family and value are at the heart of everything we do. We cultivate a community of playful personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment where our employees can be their most authentic selves. Here, we’re family.

About Cristiano Ronaldo

Cristiano Ronaldo is a Portuguese soccer player who has become one of the most well-known and talented athletes in the world. Born on February 5, 1985, in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, Ronaldo discovered his passion for soccer at a young age and quickly rose through the ranks to become one of the greatest players of all time.  
  
Known for his speed, agility, and incredible goal-scoring ability, Ronaldo has played for some of the most prestigious clubs in the world, including Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United, Real Madrid, and Juventus. His tireless work ethic, dedication to his craft, and natural talent have earned him numerous awards and accolades throughout his career, solidifying his status as one of the most influential figures in the sport.  
  
Ronaldo's professional career began in 2002 when he joined Sporting Lisbon's senior team at the age of 17. His impressive performances on the field quickly caught the attention of scouts from some of Europe's top clubs, and in 2003, he signed with Manchester United. During his time with the Red Devils, Ronaldo helped the team win three Premier League titles, one FA Cup, two League Cups, and the UEFA Champions League, establishing himself as one of the best players in the world.  
  
In 2009, Ronaldo made a record-breaking transfer to Real Madrid for a then-world-record fee of £80 million. His time at Real Madrid was nothing short of legendary, as he went on to break countless records and become the club's all-time leading goal scorer. During his nine-year tenure with the Spanish giants, Ronaldo won four Champions League titles, two La Liga titles, and numerous individual honors, including four Ballon d'Or awards, given to the best player in the world.  
  
In 2018, Ronaldo made another high-profile move, this time to Italian powerhouse Juventus. Despite the challenges of adapting to a new league and team, Ronaldo continued to shine, leading Juventus to Serie A titles and proving that his talent knows no bounds. His time with Juventus has only added to his already impressive legacy, further solidifying his status as one of the greatest players in soccer history.  
  
Off the field, Ronaldo's impact extends far beyond the game. He has used his platform to support numerous charitable causes, including donating millions of dollars to various organizations and using his social media influence to raise awareness for important issues. His philanthropy and commitment to making a positive difference in the world have earned him the admiration and respect of millions of fans around the globe.  
  
In addition to his on-field accomplishments, Ronaldo's personal life has also been widely covered by the media. A devoted father to his four children, Ronaldo has been open about the challenges and joys of parenthood, offering fans a glimpse into his life off the pitch. His dedication to his family and the values he instills in his children have only added to his image as a role model and inspiration to aspiring athletes and fans alike.  
  
As his career continues to evolve, Ronaldo's impact on the sport of soccer remains as strong as ever. His unparalleled skill, dedication, and passion for the game have set him apart as one of the most iconic athletes of his generation. Whether he's breaking records on the field or making a difference in the community, Cristiano Ronaldo's influence will undoubtedly be felt for years to come.

What types of projects does Valley Rain Construction Corporation specialize in?

Valley Rain Construction Corporation specializes in general contracting, construction management at risk (CMAR), design-build, and job order contracting (JOC). We focus primarily on public sector projects, particularly in the areas of parks, recreation, open space, and civil works. Our expertise includes the construction of sports fields, recreational facilities, and various civil construction projects.

How does Valley Rain ensure quality in its construction projects?

Valley Rain emphasizes quality through a combination of experienced personnel, rigorous project management practices, and self-performing key aspects of construction, particularly in landscape and civil works. We implement value engineering techniques to optimize project outcomes, ensuring that we meet or exceed client expectations while maintaining high standards of quality and safety throughout the construction process.

What is value engineering, and how does Valley Rain apply it in its projects?

Value engineering is a systematic method to improve the value of a project by analyzing its functions and identifying ways to reduce costs without affecting quality. At Valley Rain, we apply value engineering during the design and planning phases of our projects to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. This approach allows us to deliver high-quality results while optimizing resources and minimizing waste.

Can Valley Rain handle large-scale civil construction projects?

Yes, Valley Rain is fully equipped to manage large-scale civil construction projects. Our team has extensive experience in executing complex civil works, including infrastructure development, parks, and recreational facilities. We utilize advanced construction techniques, including automated grade controls, to ensure precision and efficiency in our operations.

What industries does Valley Rain serve?

Valley Rain primarily serves the public sector, focusing on projects related to parks, recreation, and civil works. Our clients include government agencies, municipalities, and other public entities looking to develop or enhance community spaces. We are committed to creating sustainable and functional environments that benefit the community.

How can I get a quote for a project with Valley Rain?

To obtain a quote for your project, you can contact Valley Rain directly through our website or by phone. We encourage potential clients to provide detailed information about their project requirements so that we can offer a comprehensive and accurate estimate. Our team will work closely with you to understand your vision and ensure that we meet your needs effectively.

----------------------------------------------

Adaptive Recognition America (ARA) is the North American branch of Adaptive Recognition, a technology company that for over twenty years has specialized in providing innovative hardware and software products related to optical character recognition (OCR).  
  
Through strong dedication to continuous research, Adaptive Recognition has become an industry leader in the development and manufacturing of an extensive OCR product line, which most prominently features license plate or automatic number plate recognition (LPR / ANPR), make and model recognition (MMR) and ID document reading.  
  
The core strength of the company remains focusing on the ability to apply new technologies to ever-changing customer needs, which has led to the development of superior ITS endpoint products, LPR cameras, recognition software for LPR / USDOT / ACCR (Automatic Container Code Recognition), driver's license scanners, e-passport readers.  
  
Adaptive Recognition is looking to build partnerships with value added resellers, system integrators, and other professionals in a wide variety of industries ranging from security to traffic control.

What is Inkling and how does it support employee training?

Inkling is an employee enablement platform designed to enhance the engagement and motivation of frontline workers. It transforms traditional training methods by digitizing training materials and knowledge, allowing organizations to deliver content at the speed of work. This approach ensures that employees have immediate access to the information they need, when they need it, improving learning retention and operational efficiency.

What industries does Inkling serve?

Inkling serves a variety of industries, including retail, hospitality, healthcare, and manufacturing. The platform is particularly beneficial for organizations with frontline workers who require ongoing training and support. By providing tailored solutions for each industry, Inkling helps companies improve their training processes, enhance employee performance, and drive better business outcomes.

How does Inkling facilitate onboarding for new hires?

Inkling streamlines the onboarding process by offering a comprehensive digital training solution that allows new hires to access essential information and resources from day one. The platform provides interactive content, assessments, and real-time feedback, enabling new employees to learn at their own pace. This not only accelerates their integration into the organization but also ensures they are well-prepared to perform their roles effectively.

Can Inkling be used for mobile learning?

Mobile learning through Inkling ensures that workers can stay informed and trained, regardless of their location.

What features does Inkling offer for content management and authoring?

Inkling provides robust content management and authoring tools that enable organizations to create, update, and distribute training materials efficiently. Users can easily develop interactive content, incorporate multimedia elements, and organize resources for easy access. The platform also supports version control and analytics, allowing organizations to track content usage and effectiveness, ensuring that training materials remain relevant and impactful.

How does Inkling support sales enablement?

Inkling enhances sales enablement by equipping sales teams with the training and resources they need to succeed in a fast-paced environment. The platform offers targeted training modules, product knowledge resources, and process reinforcement tools that help sales representatives stay informed about the latest offerings and best practices. This ensures that they can engage customers effectively and drive sales performance.

About The Harvard Crimson
-------------------------

The Harvard Crimson is the only breakfast-table daily newspaper in Cambridge, MA. The Crimson publishes every morning, Monday through Friday, except on federal and University holidays. In addition to the daily newspaper, The Crimson publishes an extended sports section on Mondays; Fifteen Minutes, the weekend magazine of The Crimson on Thursdays; and an arts section on Tuesdays.  
  
The Crimson is the nation's oldest continuously published daily college newspaper, and was founded in 1873 and incorporated in 1967. The newspaper traces its history to the first issue of "The Magenta," published January 24, 1873, and changed its name to "The Crimson" to reflect the new color of the college on May 21, 1875. The Crimson has a rich tradition of journalistic integrity and counts among its ranks of editorship some of America's greatest journalists. The faces of Pulitzer Prize-winning Crimson editors line the walls of The Crimson. Past editors include John F. Kennedy '40, Don Graham '65, Jeff Zucker '86, Jim Cramer '76, and Steve Ballmer '77. The name of Franklin D. Roosevelt, Class of 1904, is proudly engraved upon The Crimson's president's chair. One hundred and forty-eight years after its founding, having grown from a fortnightly newspaper to a daily, The Harvard Crimson continues to flourish with a strong body of undergraduate staff volunteers.

About Mike Tyson

Mike Tyson, the American former professional boxer, is an undeniably iconic figure in the history of boxing. Known for his fierce intensity, explosive power, and relentless aggression inside the ring, Tyson dominated the heavyweight division during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Rising to prominence at the young age of 20, he became the youngest world heavyweight champion in history, shattering records and captivating the world with his raw talent and captivating personality.  
  
Born on June 30, 1966, in Brooklyn, New York, Tyson's tumultuous childhood played a significant role in shaping his journey to boxing greatness. Growing up in a high-crime neighborhood, Tyson faced numerous challenges and often found himself resorting to violence as a means of survival. Recognizing his talent, a local boxing trainer, Cus D'Amato, took him under his wing and became his mentor. Under D'Amato's guidance, Tyson learned discipline, technique, and mental fortitude, transforming him from a troubled youth to a disciplined athlete with untapped potential.  
  
Tyson's professional career took off in 1985 when he made his debut against Hector Mercedes, winning the fight in the first round by knockout. From there, his career skyrocketed, and he quickly earned a reputation as a formidable opponent within the boxing community. His signature move, the explosive left hook, often left his opponents dazed and defeated, as he unleashed a flurry of powerful punches.  
  
In November 1986, Tyson faced his first major test against Trevor Berbick, the reigning world heavyweight champion. The fight lasted only two rounds, with Tyson delivering a devastating uppercut that sent Berbick sprawling to the canvas. At just 20 years and four months old, Tyson became the youngest heavyweight champion in history, achieving a feat that would etch his name in the record books forever. This victory marked the beginning of Tyson's reign of dominance in the heavyweight division.  
  
Over the next few years, Tyson went on an awe-inspiring rampage, demolishing opponents with a combination of skill, power, and intimidation. His athletic prowess and fierce determination earned him an aura of invincibility that captured the attention of the entire world. Known for his unrelenting pursuit of victory, Tyson's fights often ended in quick and devastating knockouts, leaving his opponents quivering on the canvas.  
  
However, despite his impressive record and undeniable talent, Tyson's career was not without controversy. In 1990, he experienced his first professional loss to James "Buster" Douglas, a stunning upset that sent shockwaves throughout the boxing community. This defeat marked the beginning of a tumultuous period in Tyson's life, including legal issues outside the ring, personal struggles, and subsequent losses in his boxing career. Despite these setbacks, Tyson remained a captivating figure, always managing to keep the world's attention.  
  
Beyond his turbulent career, Tyson's larger-than-life personality also made him a pop-culture icon. His candid and often controversial interviews, coupled with his intimidating presence, gave boxing a new dimension of intrigue. Off the boxing stage, Tyson dabbled in the entertainment industry, appearing in movies, hosting his own television show, and even releasing a memoir. His eccentricities and remarkable life story continue to captivate audiences around the world, solidifying Tyson as one of the most famous and polarizing sports figures of all time.  
  
In recent years, Tyson has embarked on a journey of personal growth and redemption. Now in his fifties, he has managed to rebuild his life, focusing on his health, family, and maintaining a positive mindset. With a renewed sense of purpose, Tyson has returned to the boxing world, announcing exhibition matches against former rivals and reigniting the interest of fans everywhere.  
  
Mike Tyson's legacy as an American former professional boxer extends far beyond the ring. From his challenging upbringing to his dominant boxing career and subsequent personal struggles, Tyson's life has been a rollercoaster ride filled with triumphs and tribulations. Regardless of his controversies, his impact on the sport of boxing cannot be denied, as he mesmerized audiences with his unique blend of athletic prowess, charisma, and raw power. With his remarkable journey still being written, Mike Tyson remains an unforgettable figure in the annals of boxing history.

About Horizon Community Church
------------------------------

Horizon Community Church started in 1975 at the Ramada Inn (now the Nyberg Woods Mall) in Tualatin, Oregon. The pioneering pastors had a vision for it to be a Bible-based, Spirit-led, genuine, authentic group of Christ-followers who would reach out to others with the love of God.  
  
God led the people to purchase the Sagert Farm in Tualatin, still the location of our elementary and middle school. Here they took an existing barn and remodeled it to become the first building for the church. Through the years, the church body added on to that building and started an elementary school as the Spirit of God made it obvious that this church would lead in the community by providing a safe place for children to attend school.  
  
The growing fellowship would soon start on another adventure to secure land at another location and build again. God spoke to our pastor first and said that he wanted to, “Build a great high school to glorify My name.” This new endeavor that the Lord sent Horizon Community Church on would bring about many remarkable miracles as the Lord brought provision to validate His will. Today we have a second, larger campus where our church, high school and pre-school/daycare meet, located on forty acres on Boones Ferry Road in Tualatin.  
  
The story of Horizon Community Church is a great God adventure, in which the people have trusted God and followed by faith in an effort to help others become followers of Jesus.

About Eric Berger

Eric Berger, as the CEO and Co-Founder of Common Sense Networks, is at the forefront of revolutionizing digital content for the next generation. With over two decades of experience in creating, growing, and leading streaming and interactive services, Eric has successfully harnessed his expertise in digital distribution and business development to build a profitable portfolio of initiatives that cater specifically to Gen Alpha. Under his leadership, Common Sense Networks has launched a creator-driven streaming platform that stands as a for-profit affiliate of the esteemed non-profit Common Sense Media, emphasizing the importance of age-appropriate content for children under 13.  
  
One of Eric's key achievements includes raising significant funding to establish a robust team and platform that has amassed the largest collection of short-form content tailored for young audiences. In just 11 months, he spearheaded the launch of this innovative service, which has since seen a remarkable 2.5x growth in audience engagement. His strategic vision and hands-on approach have not only enhanced the platform's distribution capabilities but have also fostered partnerships that amplify the reach of quality content in an increasingly crowded digital landscape.  
  
Eric's extensive background at Sony Pictures Television as Chief Digital Officer, coupled with his deep understanding of mobile devices and new media, positions him uniquely to navigate the complexities of the entertainment industry. His commitment to product marketing and VOD strategies ensures that Common Sense Networks remains a leader in delivering engaging, safe, and enriching content for children, ultimately shaping the future of family-friendly entertainment.

About First South Bank
----------------------

WELCOME TO YOU FIRST BANKING  
  
Here, we put you first, and we have for more than 100 years. “You First” banking means community bank values. Modern conveniences. Listening before talking. Understanding before solving. Building relationships. Earning trust. And doing rather than intending. It stretches across everything we say and do. We’re a true community bank – the kind of bank you’ve been waiting for, the one that puts you first.  
  
OUR VISION: to be the community bank of choice by consistently offering you-first experiences.  
  
We define the you-first experience through OUR VALUES, which employees strive to carry out daily.  
  
OUR VALUES  
  
You Create the Experience  
  
Own our Vision  
  
Understand by Listening  
  
Form Meaningful and Lasting Relationships  
  
Inspire and Be Accountable  
  
Respect and Support Others  
  
Serve our Community  
  
Tailor the Best Solution  
  
These are the guiding principles that steer our bank. These values were handcrafted by our bank, and that's why they so succinctly represent our unique personality and clearly define our passion and purpose.  
  
OUR HISTORY  
  
Founded in 1902, First South Bank has served the eastern and central North Carolina market for over 100 years. We have grown to twenty eight (28) full-service branch offices from Durham to Buxton and Elizabeth City to Wilmington. Banking products and services have evolved, however, the Bank’s commitment to its community has never wavered.  
  
OUR MISSION  
  
To be a high performing, independent community bank in eastern and central North Carolina that rewards and is valued by its shareholders, customers, employees and communities.  
  
  
To learn more, please visit firstsouthnc.com or call toll free at 888.993.7664. Member FDIC.

Launched in 2006, Amazon Web Services (AWS) began exposing key infrastructure services to businesses in the form of web services -- now widely known as cloud computing. The ultimate benefit of cloud computing, and AWS, is the ability to leverage a new business model and turn capital infrastructure expenses into variable costs. Businesses no longer need to plan and procure servers and other IT resources weeks or months in advance. Using AWS, businesses can take advantage of Amazon's expertise and economies of scale to access resources when their business needs them, delivering results faster and at a lower cost.  
  
Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. About Mark Ellenberger

Mark Ellenberger is a seasoned professional with over 30 years of experience in tanker shipping supply chain management and marketing, now channeling his extensive expertise into the world of winemaking as the co-owner and principal winemaker at Kagan Cellars. Nestled in the heart of Napa, California, Kagan Cellars is a boutique winery that marries innovative new world grape varietals with traditional old world winemaking techniques. Under Mark's leadership, the winery has gained recognition for its exceptional range of wines, which are crafted with a meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to quality.  
  
Mark's background in international project management and strategic negotiations has been instrumental in establishing Kagan Cellars as a prominent player in the competitive wine market. His skills in contract negotiation and joint ventures have facilitated fruitful partnerships that enhance the winery's distribution capabilities, allowing Kagan to ship its wines to nearly every state across the U.S. Additionally, Mark's expertise in market analysis and international marketing has enabled Kagan Cellars to effectively position its brand, ensuring that it resonates with both local and global wine enthusiasts.  
  
In tandem with his role at Kagan Cellars, Mark co-owns Mutiny Wine Room, a unique venue that showcases the artistry of winemaking while providing an immersive experience for visitors. His passion for the craft, combined with his robust business acumen, positions him as a key influencer in the wine industry, driving innovation and excellence at every turn. For those interested in exploring the fruits of his labor, Kagan Cellars offers a diverse portfolio of wines that reflect both the terroir of Napa Valley and Mark's unwavering dedication to the art of winemaking. About Whaleback Mountain
------------------------

The owner and operator of Whaleback Mountain is the Upper Valley Snow Sports Foundation.  
  
The Upper Valley Snow Sports Foundation (UVSSF) is a nonprofit entity with the mission to support and enhance an affordable, healthy, and sustainable snow sports experience in the Upper Valley of New Hampshire and Vermont. UVSSF members first came together in the spring of 2013 on the heels of Whaleback Mountain LLC shuttering operations. Like our fellow residents, we recognize the importance of Whaleback as a community asset and started our journey to purchase and operate the mountain.  
  
We took action after the Whaleback foreclosure auction on August 1, 2013 – at which time the bank retained ownership of the property – and immediately started negotiations with the bank. Those negotiations culminated with a lease and purchase agreement during the week of September 16. In December 2013 UVSSF was able to purchase the property.  
  
UVSSF is striving to preserve Whaleback because every youth and adult in the Upper Valley who wants to ski or snowboard should have an opportunity to do so at their local mountain!  
  
Family-friendly affordable skiing & riding does indeed remain a top priority, as do programs such as after-school groups, lessons, adult race league, and hosting area clubs. We will work hard to make improvements to trails, lighting and snowmaking, among other. As we are a nonprofit, fundraising is key to the long-term success of Whaleback, so we are focused on that task too. The non-profit model is working at other local mountains, from Cochran’s in VT to Mt. Spokane in WA.

What types of staffing solutions does Comrise offer?

Comrise provides a variety of staffing solutions tailored to meet the needs of different industries. Our offerings include temporary staffing, direct hire, and contract-to-hire services. We specialize in sourcing top talent for roles in IT, engineering, healthcare, and finance, ensuring that our clients have access to skilled professionals who can drive their business forward.

How does Comrise's consulting service benefit businesses?

Comrise's consulting services are designed to help businesses optimize their operations and achieve strategic goals. Our team of experienced consultants works closely with clients to identify challenges, develop tailored solutions, and implement best practices. We focus on areas such as IT strategy, process improvement, and workforce management, ensuring that our clients can leverage our expertise to enhance their performance and competitiveness.

What is RPO and how can Comrise assist with it?

RPO, or Recruitment Process Outsourcing, is a service where Comrise takes on all or part of a company's recruitment processes. We help organizations streamline their hiring by providing dedicated recruitment teams, advanced technology, and industry expertise. This allows businesses to reduce time-to-hire, improve candidate quality, and focus on their core operations while we manage the recruitment process.

Can Comrise support businesses in the technology sector?

Absolutely! Comrise has extensive experience in providing staffing and consulting services specifically for the technology sector. We understand the unique challenges and demands of this fast-paced industry and offer solutions such as managed IT services, big data solutions, and staff augmentation. Our goal is to connect tech companies with the right talent and resources to drive innovation and growth.

What industries does Comrise serve?

Comrise serves a diverse range of industries, including information technology, healthcare, finance, engineering, and telecommunications. Our comprehensive understanding of these sectors allows us to provide specialized staffing and consulting services that meet the unique needs of each industry, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible support and solutions.

How does Comrise utilize big data solutions in its services?

Comrise leverages big data solutions to enhance our staffing and consulting services. By utilizing data analytics, we can identify trends, optimize recruitment strategies, and improve workforce management. Our big data solutions also include training and payrolling services, which help organizations make data-driven decisions that enhance operational efficiency and drive business success.

About Jim Walton

Dr. Jim Walton brings a wealth of experience and expertise to his role as an Adjunct Faculty member at the University of Texas at Dallas' Jindal School of Management, where he teaches in the Healthcare Management Program. With a distinguished career culminating in a decade-long tenure as President and CEO of Genesis Physician Group, Dr. Walton has a profound understanding of the complexities of the American healthcare system. His course, "Survey of the American Healthcare System - HMGT 6320," provides students with critical insights into healthcare delivery, policy, and management, equipping them with the knowledge necessary to navigate the evolving landscape of healthcare.  
  
In addition to his teaching responsibilities, Dr. Walton has launched JWalton, LLC, a healthcare consulting and advisory firm that focuses on enhancing operational efficiency and promoting health equity within healthcare organizations. His consulting work allows him to apply his extensive experience in hospitals, social services, and managed care to real-world challenges faced by healthcare providers. Dr. Walton's expertise in HIPAA compliance, electronic health records (EHR), and Medicaid systems further enriches his curriculum, ensuring that students are well-prepared for careers in healthcare management.  
  
Dr. Walton's commitment to fostering the next generation of healthcare leaders is evident in his engaging teaching style and his dedication to student success. His unique blend of practical experience and academic insight makes him a valuable asset to the Jindal School of Management and a respected figure in the healthcare community. Through his work, he continues to influence the future of healthcare management, emphasizing the importance of leadership and innovation in achieving better health outcomes for all.

Best known for her iconic role as Hermione Granger in the "Harry Potter" film series, Watson has since proven herself as a versatile actress in a variety of films, showcasing her range and depth as an artist.  
  
Born on April 15, 1990, in Paris, France, Emma Watson spent her early years in Oxfordshire, England. From a young age, her passion for acting was evident. She attended the Dragon School, where she performed in school plays, and her talent soon caught the attention of casting agents.  
  
In 2001, at the tender age of 11, Watson made her debut on the big screen as Hermione Granger in "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone." The film's immense success transformed her into an instant global superstar and brought her worldwide acclaim. As Hermione, Watson portrayed a strong, intelligent, and fiercely loyal character, which resonated with audiences of all ages. She went on to reprise her role as Hermione in all eight installments of the "Harry Potter" series, leading her to become one of the highest-paid actresses in the world.  
  
While her success with the "Harry Potter" franchise could have easily pigeonholed her as the beloved Hermione Granger indefinitely, Watson was determined to break free from the shadow of her iconic character. As the series came to an end in 2011, she wasted no time in pursuing other challenging roles in order to showcase her versatility as an actress.  
  
In 2012, Watson starred in "The Perks of Being a Wallflower," a coming-of-age film that explored themes of love, friendship, and self-discovery. Her portrayal of Sam, a free-spirited teenager, was praised by both critics and audiences alike, earning her widespread recognition as a serious actress beyond her Harry Potter fame. With this film, Watson proved that she could hold her own outside the magical world of Hogwarts.  
  
One of Watson's most notable roles came in 2017 with the live-action adaptation of Disney's "Beauty and the Beast." Playing the iconic character of Belle, she mesmerized audiences with her enchanting performance. Watson effortlessly brought to life Belle's intelligence, bravery, and unwavering independence. Her portrayal not only demonstrated her ability to tackle complex characters but also showcased her remarkable singing voice. The film was a massive success, grossing over $1.2 billion worldwide, solidifying Watson as one of Hollywood's most bankable stars.  
  
Aside from her acting career, Watson is known for her activism and dedication to social causes. In 2014, she was appointed as a UN Women Goodwill Ambassador and launched the HeForShe campaign, advocating for gender equality. Her passionate speeches about feminism and women's rights have inspired a new generation of activists and transformed her into a powerful voice for change.  
  
Despite her fame and success, Watson has always maintained a grounded and humble attitude. Known for her intelligence and love for education, she attended Brown University, where she completed her Bachelor's degree in English Literature. She has never shied away from embracing her intellect and has been vocal about the importance of education in her own life and the lives of girls worldwide.  
  
In summary, Emma Watson is not just a talented actress but also an influential figure and passionate advocate. From her humble beginnings as Hermione Granger in the "Harry Potter" films to her dynamic roles in various genres, Watson has proven time and time again that she is a force to be reckoned with in the entertainment industry. His adeptness in change management and IT strategy has been crucial during office closures and openings, ensuring that transitions are smooth and minimally disruptive. With a strong foundation in analytics and consulting, Bill Hall continues to drive Applied Systems forward, leveraging technology to enhance productivity and foster collaboration across global teams. About Aurora Chorus

Since 1992, Aurora Chorus has honored the strength and beauty of women's lives through the fine art of choral singing. Aurora was founded on the belief that music can be a powerful instrument of peace, locally, globally, and in the hearts of all who listen and all who sing. In an atmosphere of personal growth and cooperation, Aurora is proud to provide both novice and experienced singers with an unparalleled opportunity to expand and transform a love of singing into an understanding and appreciation of healthy vocal production, choral technique, musical expression and literacy.  
  
Led by director Joan Szymko, Aurora Chorus consists of over 100 singers from the Portland/Vancouver metro area, presents two full length concerts each season, and performs at community outreach events throughout the year. Aurora has produced two full length CD recordings: "Full Circle" and "Solstice."

About Genus PLC

Genus is a world-leading animal genetics company.  
  
At the forefront of innovation in gene-editing, advanced reproductive biology, and other breakthrough breeding technologies, Genus R&D advances an agricultural practice thousands of years old – animal breeding. Our goal is to ensure the global food system continues to nurture healthy, productive animals that yield affordable, high-quality proteins for a sustainable future. We believe a more sustainable food system starts with better breeding and genetics.  
  
Through ABS Global (bovine) and PIC (porcine), we supply high-quality breeding animals with desirable characteristics to farmers, enabling them to produce better quality meat and milk more efficiently to feed the world more sustainably. Our breeding animals’ desirable characteristics include feed efficiency, disease resistance, growth rate, protein and fat content, and fertility.  
  
ABS Global is the world-leading provider of bovine genetics, reproduction services, technologies, and udder care products. Marketing in more than 70 countries around the globe, ABS has been at the forefront of animal genetics and technology since its founding in 1941. In bovine genetics, ABS serves more than 40,000 customers globally, including some of the world’s leading beef and dairy producers.  
  
PIC, which stands for ‘Pig Improvement Company,’ was founded in 1962 in Oxfordshire, England. PIC strives to make their customers the most successful pig producers in the world and their “Never Stop Improving” philosophy means a continuous effort to listen carefully to customers and drive innovation to create ever-increasing value for pig and pork producers.

About Bill Maher

Bill Maher is an exceptionally accomplished American comedian and writer who has made his mark on the world of comedy and entertainment through his unique brand of satirical humor and fearless political commentary. Known for his sharp wit, Maher has cemented his place as a significant figure in the industry, captivating audiences with his incisive and often controversial insights.  
  
Born on January 20, 1956, in New York City, Maher developed a passion for comedy at an early age. He cultivated his talents through regular appearances in comedy clubs and open mic nights, ultimately catching the eye of industry insiders. His breakthrough came in the 1980s when he became a regular contributor and standout performer on the hit late-night talk show, "The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson." This exposure propelled Maher to new heights, granting him an expanded platform to showcase his razor-sharp observational comedy.  
  
Throughout his career, Maher has not shied away from addressing taboo subjects or using his platform to express his polarizing views. His trademark blend of political satire and social commentary has earned him both devoted fans and fierce critics. As a self-proclaimed political commentator, Maher has remained at the forefront of American politics, utilizing his platform to explore contentious issues such as religion, race, and gender politics.  
  
Maher is renowned for fearlessly challenging the status quo and confronting controversial figures on his long-running, critically acclaimed HBO talk show, "Real Time with Bill Maher." The show features a variety of segments, including one-on-one interviews, panel discussions, and a lively roundtable format where Maher navigates complex issues with his characteristic intellectual rigor and quick-witted banter.  
  
In addition to his television success, Maher has left an indelible impact in the literary world, authoring numerous best-selling books. His first book, "True Story," released in 1994, intertwines memoir and political commentary, showcasing Maher's talent for weaving personal anecdotes with astute social analysis. Subsequent books, such as "When You Ride Alone, You Ride with Bin Laden" and "The New New Rules: A Funny Look at How Everybody but Me Has Their Head Up Their Ass," further solidified his status as a thought-provoking and uncompromising social commentator.  
  
Beyond his comedy and writing, Maher is recognized for his philanthropic efforts and involvement in environmental and political activism. He has actively advocated for climate change action, hosting the documentary "The Unnatural History of the Sea" and supporting organization initiatives including the National Resources Defense Council. Maher has also been a prominent voice in the movement to legalize marijuana, using his platform to highlight the shortcomings of the criminal justice system and push for drug policy reform.  
  
Ultimately, Bill Maher's career is marked by the boldness and audacity with which he unapologetically tackles pressing social and political issues. His unique ability to entertain while challenging audiences to question conventional wisdom has solidified his status as a comedic icon and intellectual provocateur. Maher's influence extends far beyond the realm of comedy, making him an important figure in American popular culture, provoking conversations and inspiring change through his irreverent humor and insightful commentaries.

GPS is a consulting firm in Metro Detroit serving clients in both the private and public sector by navigating their journey toward Operational Excellence. Our team of subject matter experts is comprised of engineers – chemical, industrial and mechanical – with masters and doctorate degrees but who also have business acumen to complement their technical skills and practical experience. Most importantly, GPS consultants have demonstrated their ability to engage people to get sustainable results.  
  
We have a diverse client base from small cap companies to Fortune 50 corporations in various industries including food and consumer products, automotive, chemical and other industrial sectors, healthcare, and private equity as well as public sectors at the federal, state and municipal level.  
  
WHAT WE DO  
  
GPS is the best in the industry at implementing business and process improvement solutions to achieve breakthrough productivity.  
  
Our proven model quickly determines baseline business process capability, exposing losses and identifying performance gaps and quantifies the financial opportunity of closing those gaps. We then get to work on the operational improvements to deliver breakthrough results within 90 days and create a self-funding plan to execute the longer-term business improvement strategy.  
  
GPS doesn’t subscribe to the latest management fads but adapts to our clients’ culture, whether we are providing interim resources to create momentum or delivering specific tool training and certification to enhance organizational capability.

In addition to his ownership of the Hornets, Michael has made a name for himself in the fashion industry. The brand has achieved global recognition and has become synonymous with high-quality products and innovative design. Michael's business savvy and keen sense of branding have played a significant role in the success of the Jordan Brand, solidifying his reputation as a savvy and influential entrepreneur.  
  
Beyond his accomplishments in sports and business, Michael is also known for his philanthropy and community involvement. He has been a staunch advocate for social causes and has used his platform to support various charitable initiatives. His philanthropic efforts have touched the lives of countless individuals, and he continues to make a positive impact through his charitable work.  
  
In all aspects of his career, Jordan Michael has exemplified excellence and determination. His impact on the world of basketball is undeniable, and his entrepreneurial success serves as an inspiration to aspiring business leaders. About Stephen Colbert

Stephen Colbert is a celebrated American comedian, writer, television host, and political satirist. Known for his quick wit, charming demeanor, and razor-sharp intellect, Colbert has carved a niche for himself in the entertainment industry as a master of parody and political commentary. His signature style effortlessly blends humor and incisive social critique, making him a beloved figure both within and beyond the realm of comedy.  
  
Born and raised in Washington, D.C., Colbert’s passion for humor and performance developed at an early age. He honed his comedic skills while studying theater at Northwestern University, where he joined the improvisational troupe, Second City. Colbert’s talent was undeniable, and he soon caught the attention of acclaimed comedian and television host Jon Stewart, leading to his breakthrough role as a correspondent on "The Daily Show with Jon Stewart."  
  
Colbert’s work on "The Daily Show" catapulted him to mainstream success and provided a platform for him to showcase his unique brand of satire. His character, a pompous and conservative news correspondent, became an instant hit with audiences, who recognized Colbert's unparalleled ability to deliver biting social and political commentary with a straight face. The character was so beloved that it eventually led to his own spin-off show, "The Colbert Report."  
  
"The Colbert Report" debuted in 2005 and quickly became a cult favorite. Styled as a parody of right-wing news pundits, the show saw Colbert adopting a persona characterized by exaggerated political bias and ego. Through his mock conservative personality, Colbert fearlessly exposed the absurdity and hypocrisy of contemporary politics and media. The program's success earned Colbert multiple accolades, including several Primetime Emmy Awards, and made him an essential voice in American comedy and political discourse.  
  
In 2014, Colbert embarked on a new chapter in his career as he succeeded the iconic David Letterman as the host of "The Late Show." This transition allowed Colbert to showcase his versatility and reach an even broader audience. Shedding his satirical persona, he brought his unique blend of humor and intelligence to the traditional late-night talk show format. Utilizing interviews, monologues, and sketches, Colbert infused his show with a distinct political edge, cementing his reputation as a comedic force to be reckoned with.  
  
Colbert's impact extends far beyond the late-night realm. Through his work, he has tackled numerous social and political issues, including income inequality, racism, and the influence of money in politics. His ability to address serious and complex subjects while still maintaining a comedic tone has earned him widespread admiration and respect. His biting critiques of the Trump administration, in particular, made him a figurehead for those seeking humorous and astute commentary during a tumultuous political era.  
  
Beyond his television work, Colbert has also contributed to the literary world. In 2007, he released a best-selling book, "I Am America (And So Can You!)," which humorously dissected various aspects of American society and culture. Colbert has also lent his talent to other means of entertainment, such as hosting the Emmy Awards and voicing animated characters in movies like "Mr. Peabody & Sherman" and "The Penguins of Madagascar."  
  
Throughout his career, Stephen Colbert has displayed an unparalleled ability to navigate the fine line between comedy and social commentary. As an American comedian and writer, he seamlessly blends hilarity with insight, challenging the status quo while providing much-needed comic relief. Whether through his groundbreaking television shows, his books, or his insightful interviews, Colbert continues to captivate audiences with his wit, intellect, and unwavering dedication to making people laugh and think.

About Celeste Ng

Celeste Ng is an American writer and novelist known for her compelling storytelling and knack for tackling complex familial and societal dynamics. Born and raised in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Ng developed a passion for writing at a young age and went on to pursue her love of literature at Harvard University, where she earned a degree in English and spent time honing her craft. After graduating, Ng continued to delve into the world of writing, ultimately making a name for herself as a skilled and captivating author.  
  
Ng burst onto the literary scene with her debut novel, "Everything I Never Told You," which was published in 2014 to critical acclaim. The novel, which explores the themes of identity, family, and the weight of unspoken truths, quickly became a bestseller and earned Ng widespread recognition as a talented new voice in contemporary fiction. "Everything I Never Told You" was lauded for its poignant portrayal of a Chinese American family in 1970s Ohio and its deep exploration of the complexities of human relationships. Ng's ability to craft fully realized characters and immerse readers in their emotional journeys has solidified her reputation as a writer with a deep understanding of the human experience.  
  
Following the success of her debut, Ng went on to write "Little Fires Everywhere," a literary tour de force that further solidified her status as a literary powerhouse. Published in 2017, the novel quickly gained traction for its compelling narrative and incisive commentary on race, class, and privilege in contemporary America. Set in the picture-perfect suburb of Shaker Heights, Ohio, "Little Fires Everywhere" follows the intertwined lives of two families and delves into the complexities of motherhood, identity, and the enduring impact of secrets. Ng's ability to infuse her storytelling with empathy and insight has resonated with readers, and "Little Fires Everywhere" garnered widespread acclaim, earning Ng a place on the New York Times bestseller list and cementing her status as a literary force to be reckoned with.  
  
In addition to her novels, Ng has also made a name for herself as a thought-provoking essayist and commentator. Her writing has been featured in a variety of esteemed publications, including The New York Times, The Guardian, and The Paris Review, where she has tackled topics ranging from the immigrant experience to the role of literature in shaping our understanding of the world. Ng's ability to critically engage with pressing social issues while maintaining a deeply personal and introspective approach has earned her a dedicated following of readers who appreciate her thought-provoking and emotionally resonant writing.  
  
Ng's work has also garnered significant attention in the world of adaptation, with both of her novels being adapted for the screen. "Everything I Never Told You" is currently in development as a television series, while "Little Fires Everywhere" was adapted into a highly successful Hulu miniseries starring Reese Witherspoon and Kerry Washington. The adaptation of "Little Fires Everywhere" received widespread acclaim for its thoughtful exploration of the novel's themes and its compelling portrayal of the complex characters Ng created. The success of both adaptations further solidifies Ng's position as a storyteller whose work transcends the page and resonates across different mediums.  
  
In addition to her success as a writer, Ng has also been recognized for her contributions to the literary community, earning accolades such as the Dayton Literary Peace Prize and the Massachusetts Book Award. As a prominent voice in contemporary literature, Ng has used her platform to advocate for diverse storytelling and to spotlight the work of underrepresented writers. Her commitment to amplifying marginalized voices and challenging readers to engage with new perspectives has made Ng an influential figure in the literary world.  
  
As Celeste Ng continues to captivate readers with her insightful and emotionally resonant storytelling, her impact on the literary landscape only continues to grow. With her keen understanding of human relationships and her ability to craft narratives that resonate on a deeply personal level, Ng has established herself as a writer whose work transcends boundaries and remains firmly entrenched in the hearts and minds of her readers. As she continues to explore the complexities of identity, family, and society in her writing, Ng's powerful voice will undoubtedly leave an indelible mark on the world of contemporary literature for years to come.

About Juguettos
---------------

Juguettos es una cooperativa española fundada en Villena (Alicante) en 1975 por un grupo de pequeños jugueteros de las provincias de Alicante, Albacete y Murcia. En actualidad está compuesta por 54 socios y cuenta con un total de 256 puntos de venta distribuidos por toda España y Andorra, y una delegación comercial en Hong Kong.  
La compañía ha mantenido en los últimos 10 años un crecimiento orgánico que ha hecho posible que la enseña esté presente en toda la geografía española, con una media de 10 nuevas aperturas anuales, alcanzando en 2016 los 258 puntos de venta.  
Con una plantilla formada por más de 1.500 empleados, cifra que aumenta hasta un 40% durante la campaña de Navidad, y más de 110.000 m2 de superficie de exposición, Juguettos se ha consolidado como una de las principales cadenas detallistas del sector del juguete en España, con una cuota de mercado superior al 9%.  
La enseña también ha logrado afianzar una amplia gama de productos de marca propia, con un total de 16 líneas y 800 referencias. En este sentido, en el año 1998 la cooperativa fue pionera dentro de su sector en desarrollar este modelo de negocio, así como en lanzar el primer catálogo específico de juguetes en el año 1986. Hoy edita 9 millones de catálogos al año.

About Hampton Water Wine Co.
----------------------------

Jesse Bongiovi and his dad Jon Bon Jovi shared a vision to disrupt the wine category with a wine brand that is unlike the others. The two, along with Ali Thomas, created the full concept of the brand and brought on famed French winemaker, Gerard Bertrand. The wine is fresh and lively, and its aging in New French Oak barrels for 30-60 days makes it less acidic and more enjoyable to drink than other rosés from the South of France.  
  
Hampton Water rosé is not just another celebrity product, it’s a father-and-son, family business that has earned four consecutive 90-point ratings from Wine Spectator, earned a spot on both WS and Wine Enthusiast Top 100 lists, has been awarded Market Watch’s Best New Product in Wine, and has earned a Wine and Culture Wine Star Award from Wine Enthusiast.  
  
With an incredibly engaged social media presence of over 500,000 followers, Hampton Water is making waves by taking a modern approach in an often traditional category. With only 5 years under their belt, they are creating loyal brand advocates, surpassing their category, and delivering double-digit volume growth year over year.

About Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA)
-----------------------------------------------

The Defense Contract Management Agency is, first and foremost, a product delivery organization. Our nation’s warfighters expect our defense industry to produce and deliver the equipment they need to fight, survive and win. DCMA’s integrated team of acquisition and support professionals makes this happen.  
The Agency provides contract administration services for the Department of Defense, other federal organizations and international partners, and is an essential part of the acquisition process from pre-award to sustainment. Around 12,000 employees, mostly civilians, work at offices and contractor facilities around the world, divided among three continental U.S. commands, one international command and other specialized offices.  
Together, the Agency manages 300,000 contracts, valued at more than $7 trillion, at 15,000 contractor locations worldwide. DCMA makes sure DoD, other federal agencies, and partner nation customers get the equipment they need, delivered on time, at projected cost, and meeting all performance requirements.  
Every business day, DCMA receives nearly 1,000 new contracts and authorizes more than $700 million in payments to contractors. Most importantly, every day our team delivers more than a million and a half items – from fighter jets to fasteners – to our warfighters.

The Arcanum Group provides a range of technical and program support solutions tailored to the unique challenges faced by public sector organizations. Our Construction Management services encompass the entire project lifecycle, from planning and design to execution and completion. About Malvern Theatres
----------------------

Malvern Theatres welcomes hundreds of thousands of highly-engaged visitors through its doors every year to enjoy the venue’s world-class entertainment. Open 364 days a year, it offers a unique year-round opportunity to communicate your brand messages to its discerning audiences.  
  
Architecturally celebrated, Malvern Theatres is a destination venue set in historic landscaped gardens that offers an unusual opportunity for premium corporate hospitality. It boasts the finest quality touring theatre and entertainment available, attracting interested and intelligent audiences both in person and online.  
  
Malvern Theatres is an arts charity, with only 1% of its running costs publicly funded. By supporting the theatre, businesses are also helping their community.  
  
The theatre is committed to training the next generation of theatre professionals, offering everything from drama classes and prop making for youngsters, to trainee placements for young adults, an advanced course for aspiring arts professionals and its own celebrated Young Company.  
  
As well as offering world-class entertainment, Malvern Theatres runs several weekly workshops, such as dance classes for over 55s, creative arts for those with learning disabilities, and stagecraft for the young, as well as bespoke workshops for those with special needs.  
  
Malvern Theatres is committed to making the arts accessible for all. It has a flourishing programme of ‘Relaxed’ Performances, led by trained staff, and works with many local primary schools.

About Babcock Canada Inc.
-------------------------

Babcock Canada Inc., headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the esteemed Babcock International Group, a prominent player in the Aerospace, Defence, and Security sectors. With a commitment to delivering value-added services, Babcock Canada operates across multiple countries, including Canada, the UK, France, Australia, and South Africa. The company excels in two primary domains: Marine and Aviation.  
  
In the Marine sector, Babcock Canada stands out as a leading member of Team Victoria-Class, leveraging both Canadian expertise and global experience in submarine sustainment. The company has cultivated an unparalleled understanding of the Victoria-Class Submarine platform, supported by a robust Canadian supply chain. This positions Babcock as one of Canada’s foremost experts and trusted partners in submarine in-service support, ensuring the operational readiness and longevity of critical naval assets.  
  
In the Aviation domain, Babcock operates a diverse fleet of fixed and rotary-wing military and commercial aircraft, providing essential services such as remote medical emergencies, civil protection, search and rescue, surveillance, firefighting, and defence operations. The company is a pre-qualified bidder for the Future Aircrew Training program (FAcT), which aims to enhance military flying training for the Royal Canadian Air Force. With aviation experience spanning 14 countries, Babcock integrates global expertise to deliver customized solutions tailored to Canadian needs. Recent contracts awarded by the Government of Manitoba for aerial wildfire suppression and Critical Care air medical transportation underscore Babcock’s commitment to providing fully integrated, professional services, underpinned by proprietary technology and specialized pilot training. Through these efforts, Babcock Canada continues to contribute significantly to national security and public safety.

About Priscilla Presley

Priscilla Presley is an iconic American businesswoman and actress who has captivated audiences with her talent, beauty, and entrepreneurial spirit. Widely recognized as the former wife of the legendary Elvis Presley, Priscilla carved a path of her own, establishing herself as a successful businesswoman and contributing significantly to the entertainment industry.  
  
Born on May 24, 1945, in Brooklyn, New York, Priscilla grew up in a middle-class family. Her father served in the United States Navy, and her mother worked as a homemaker. With her striking looks and graceful demeanor, it was only a matter of time before Priscilla caught the attention of many. At the age of 14, her family relocated to Germany due to her father's military assignment, and it was there that her life took a tremendous turn.  
  
It was in Germany that Priscilla would meet the man who would change her life forever – the king of rock and roll himself, Elvis Presley. The two first crossed paths in 1959 when Elvis was serving in the U.S. Army and stationed in Germany. They quickly formed a connection, and by the time Elvis left Germany, their bond had grown stronger. Priscilla moved to Memphis, Tennessee, after finishing high school and soon found herself in the whirlwind world of fame and fortune.  
  
It was not an easy journey for Priscilla, who had to navigate the challenges of being in a relationship with one of the biggest stars in the entertainment industry. She managed to captivate Elvis with her beauty and charm, and the two got married in 1967. However, their relationship faced strains due to the immense pressure of fame, Elvis's demanding schedule, and the constant scrutiny from the public. They eventually divorced in 1973 but remained close friends until Elvis's untimely death in 1977.  
  
Even after Elvis's passing, Priscilla's association with the legend never faded away. Instead of succumbing to the shadows of his legacy, she used her experience and knowledge to build a successful career of her own. Priscilla made her mark in the entertainment industry, showcasing her talent as an actress. Notable appearances include her role in the hit television series "Dallas" from 1983 to 1988, where she played Jenna Wade. Her performances were praised for their depth and versatility, proving that she was more than just the ex-wife of a celebrity.  
  
Beyond her acting endeavors, Priscilla Presley has become a highly successful businesswoman. In 1984, she became the co-founder of Elvis Presley Enterprises, a company dedicated to managing Elvis's estate and preserving his legacy. Under her leadership, the company has grown exponentially, expanding its reach globally and diversifying its offerings. Priscilla's forward-thinking approach and business acumen have ensured that Elvis's name continues to thrive even decades after his passing.  
  
Priscilla's love and dedication to preserving Elvis's memory can be seen in her ongoing involvement with Graceland, the iconic Presley mansion in Memphis. She played an instrumental role in transforming Graceland into a world-renowned tourist attraction, opening its doors to fans from all over the globe. Priscilla has overseen numerous expansions and improvements at Graceland, ensuring that the legacy of Elvis Presley remains alive and accessible to all.  
  
In addition to her accomplishments in business and entertainment, Priscilla has tirelessly supported charitable causes close to her heart. She is a committed advocate for animal welfare, serving on the board of directors for various organizations focused on protecting animals from cruelty and improving their overall well-being. Priscilla's compassion and dedication have earned her numerous accolades, including the prestigious Linda McCartney Award for her work on behalf of animals.  
  
Priscilla Presley's journey is a testament to the power of resilience, determination, and reinvention. From her humble beginnings in Brooklyn to her rise to stardom alongside Elvis Presley, she has consistently demonstrated her ability to adapt and excel in any endeavor she pursued. Priscilla's impact on the entertainment industry, business world, and philanthropy has solidified her as an American icon in her own right, leaving an indelible mark on the hearts of millions, just as Elvis did.

The Shefa School is a new Jewish community day school in Manhattan, currently serving students in grades 2-8. Shefa will ultimately enroll children in grades 1-8 who would benefit from a specialized educational environment in order to develop their strengths while addressing their learning challenges. We specifically serve students with language-based learning disabilities who have not yet reached their potential levels of success in traditional classroom settings. Shefa is a pluralistic community school serving families across the range of Jewish involvement and observance.Even among the excellent schooling options available to families, there existed an unmet need at the nexus of Jewish day schools and secular special education schools. Doja Cat, the American rapper and singer, is the epitome of versatility and creativity in the music industry. With her infectious blend of hip-hop, R&B, and pop, she has captivated millions around the world, establishing herself as a true force to be reckoned with. Born Amala Ratna Zandile Dlaminion on October 21, 1995, in Los Angeles, California, Doja Cat's journey to stardom is a testament to her talent and determination.  
  
Doja Cat's music career began in 2014 when she released her debut EP titled "Purrr!" The project showcased her unique style and lyrical prowess, instantly garnering attention from critics and fans alike. However, it was her breakout single, "Mooo!", that catapulted her into the mainstream. With its catchy hook and quirky visuals, "Mooo!" became a viral sensation, amassing millions of views on YouTube and propelling Doja Cat into the spotlight.  
  
Building on the success of "Mooo!", Doja Cat released her debut studio album, "Amala," in 2018. The album showcased her versatility as an artist, seamlessly blending genres and experimenting with different sounds. Tracks like "Go To Town" and "Roll With Us" demonstrated her ability to create infectious, anthemic songs with a unique twist, while more introspective tracks like "Casual" showcased her vulnerability and depth as a songwriter.  
  
Doja Cat's breakthrough moment came in 2019 with the release of her hit single, "Say So." The song dominated the charts, reaching number one on the Billboard Hot 100 and propelling her to global superstardom. With its disco-infused beats, catchy melodies, and empowering lyrics, "Say So" captured the hearts of millions, solidifying Doja Cat's status as a true pop icon.  
  
Beyond her musical prowess, Doja Cat is also celebrated for her dynamic personality and unapologetic approach to self-expression. She embraces her uniqueness and encourages her fans to do the same, creating a sense of inclusivity and empowerment within her fan base. Whether she's donning glamorous outfits or showcasing her unmatched dance moves, Doja Cat's larger-than-life persona shines through in every aspect of her artistry.  
  
In addition to her solo endeavors, Doja Cat has also collaborated with some of the industry's biggest stars, further cementing her versatility and ability to adapt to different musical styles. Her collaborations with artists like Gucci Mane on "Like That" and The Weeknd on the remix of "In Your Eyes" have showcased her ability to seamlessly navigate between hip-hop, pop, and R&B, further expanding her fan base and solidifying her presence in the music industry.  
  
Doja Cat's impact extends beyond her music, as she continues to break barriers and challenge societal norms. In 2021, she made history as the first-ever solo female rapper to win the Video of the Year award at the MTV Video Music Awards for her hit single "Kiss Me More" featuring SZA. This achievement not only highlights her own success but also represents a pivotal moment for female artists in the male-dominated rap genre.  
  
As Doja Cat continues to evolve as an artist, there's no doubt that she will leave an indelible mark on the music industry. Her ability to effortlessly combine various genres, her infectious energy, and her unwavering commitment to authenticity all contribute to her continued success and cement her place among the greats. Whether she's dominating the charts or captivating audiences with her captivating live performances, Doja Cat's star power knows no bounds. She is a true visionary and a force to be reckoned with, and her impact on the music industry will undoubtedly be felt for years to come.

What is Southwest Airlines' policy on baggage?

Southwest Airlines allows each passenger to check two bags for free, provided they meet the size and weight restrictions. Each bag must not exceed 50 pounds (23 kg) and 62 linear inches (157 cm) in combined dimensions. Additionally, passengers are allowed one carry-on bag and one personal item, such as a backpack or purse, at no extra charge. It's important to note that certain items, like oversized sports equipment or musical instruments, may incur additional fees.

How can I change or cancel my Southwest Airlines flight?

You can change or cancel your flight through the Southwest Airlines website or mobile app. Simply log in to your account, navigate to 'Manage Reservations,' and select the flight you wish to modify. If you cancel your flight, you will receive travel credit for the amount paid, which can be used for future travel within a year. Note that changes made to your flight may incur fare differences, but there are no change fees.

Does Southwest Airlines offer any rewards program?

Yes, Southwest Airlines has a rewards program called Rapid Rewards. Members earn points for every dollar spent on flights, as well as for hotel stays, car rentals, and purchases with partner companies. Points can be redeemed for free flights, upgrades, and other travel-related benefits. Membership is free, and there are no blackout dates for redeeming points on flights.

What health and safety measures does Southwest Airlines have in place?

Southwest Airlines prioritizes the health and safety of its passengers and crew. The airline has implemented enhanced cleaning protocols, including the use of electrostatic sprayers to disinfect aircraft, and has increased the frequency of cleaning high-touch surfaces. Masks are encouraged for all passengers, and the airline follows guidelines from the CDC and local health authorities to ensure a safe travel experience.

Can I bring my pet on a Southwest Airlines flight?

Yes, Southwest Airlines allows small pets to travel in the cabin for a fee. Pets must be transported in an approved carrier that fits under the seat in front of you. The combined weight of the pet and carrier should not exceed 20 pounds (9 kg). Reservations for pet travel should be made in advance, as there are limits on the number of pets allowed in the cabin per flight.

What should I do if I lost something on a Southwest Airlines flight?

If you believe you lost an item on a Southwest Airlines flight, you should report it as soon as possible. You can do this by visiting the Southwest Airlines website and navigating to the 'Lost & Found' section, where you can submit a lost item report. Additionally, you can contact the airline's customer service for assistance. Be sure to provide details about the flight, the item, and where you think you may have left it.

The Ohio State Bar Association, founded in 1880, is a voluntary professional association open to any person who has been admitted to the practice of law. Law school students, paralegal students, and paralegals and legal administrators are eligible for membership in the OSBA as associate members.  
  
The OSBA represents more than 25,000 Ohio lawyers and judges, nearly 68 percent of Ohio law practitioners. Total membership is about 30,000, which includes associate members.  
  
From the date of its founding until today, the Association’s working goals have been to:  
  
\* advance the science of jurisprudence;  
\* promote improvement of the law and administration of justice;  
\* uphold integrity, honor and courtesy in the legal profession and  
encourage and enforce adherence to high standards of professional  
conduct;  
\* take positions on matters of public interest as deemed advisable;  
\* encourage thorough legal education  
\* cultivate cordial relations among members of the Bar; and  
\* perpetuate the history of the profession and the Association.  
  
As Ohio’s largest network of legal professionals, the OSBA’s mission is to improve access to justice for all Ohioans, advance the legal profession and advocate for our members.  
  
Our core values are member satisfaction, professionalism, foresight, and quality services and products. Our goal is to make membership in the Ohio State Bar Association indispensable to Ohio lawyers.

About Brooklyn Academy of Music
-------------------------------

BAM (Brooklyn Academy of Music) is a multi-arts center located in Brooklyn, New York. For more than 150 years, BAM has been the home for adventurous artists, audiences, and ideas—engaging both global and local communities. With world-renowned programming in theater, dance, music, opera, film, and much more, BAM showcases the work of emerging artists and innovative modern masters.  
  
BAM presents leading national and international artists and companies in its annual Spring Season and highlights groundbreaking, contemporary work in the performing arts with its Next Wave Festival each fall. Founded in 1983, the Next Wave Festival is one of the world's most important festivals of contemporary performing arts. BAM Rose Cinemas features new, independent film releases and BAMcinématek—a curated, daily repertory film program. In 2012, BAM added the Richard B. Fisher Building to its campus, providing an intimate and flexible 250-seat performance venue—the Fishman Space—as well as the Hillman Studio, a rehearsal and performance space.  
  
BAM serves New York City's diverse population through a weekend concert series in BAMcafé, community events, literary series, and a wide variety of educational and family programs. BAM, America's oldest performing arts center, has presented performances since 1861, and attracts an audience of more than 650,000 people each year.  
  
  
Career opportunities at BAM can be found at www.bam.org/about/careers

About Mike Smith

Mike Smith is a Canadian ice hockey goaltender known for his extraordinary athleticism, lightning-fast reflexes, and unmatched competitive spirit. Born and raised in Kingston, Ontario, Smith began his journey on the ice at a young age, showcasing immense potential that would eventually lead him to one of the most successful careers in the sport.  
  
Standing at an imposing 6 feet 5 inches and weighing in at 220 pounds, Smith is a formidable presence between the pipes. His towering frame, combined with his exceptional agility and flexibility, allows him to cover the net with remarkable ease. With lightning-quick reflexes, he can make split-second decisions and instinctively thwart any scoring opportunity that comes his way.  
  
Smith's passion for hockey developed at a young age, honing his skills in local leagues before being drafted by the Kingston Frontenacs of the Ontario Hockey League (OHL). His abilities were evident from the start, and he quickly established himself as a crucial player for the team. In his final season with the Frontenacs, Smith led the league with an impressive 2.22 goals-against average, showcasing his unrivaled talent even at the junior level.  
  
Following his success in the OHL, Smith was selected by the Dallas Stars in the fifth round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft. This marked the beginning of his professional career, and he wasted no time making an impact. After impressing the Stars' management during training camp, he was called up to the NHL in the 2006-2007 season and made his debut against the Phoenix Coyotes.  
  
In the years that followed, Smith would go on to play for various teams in the NHL, including the Tampa Bay Lightning and Arizona Coyotes, further solidifying his reputation as an exceptional goaltender. However, it was during his tenure with the Coyotes that Smith's brilliance truly shone. In the 2011-2012 season, he led the team to their first playoff appearance in eight years, electrifying fans with his exceptional performances and stealing games single-handedly.  
  
One of Smith's most memorable moments came during the 2012 playoffs, with the Coyotes facing off against the Chicago Blackhawks in the Western Conference Quarterfinals. In game six, with the series tied at three games apiece, Smith stood on his head, stopping a staggering 39 shots en route to a 4-0 shutout victory. His stellar play in these high-pressure situations earned him the reputation of being an "X-factor" capable of single-handedly changing the outcome of a game.  
  
Off the ice, Smith's hard work and dedication are evident. He is known for his rigorous training routines, which include weightlifting, yoga, and a vigorous cardiovascular program. These grueling workouts not only enhance his already outstanding physical abilities but also ensure that he remains at the top of his game.  
  
In addition to his individual achievements, Smith has also represented Canada on the international stage. He has donned the red and white jersey on numerous occasions, accumulating an impressive array of medals. Notably, he won a gold medal as a member of Team Canada at the 2014 Winter Olympics in Sochi, Russia. Smith's remarkable performances in the tournament showcased his ability to thrive on the international stage.  
  
Throughout his career, Mike Smith has garnered the respect and admiration of fans, fellow players, and coaches alike. His incredible athleticism, unwavering determination, and relentless work ethic have made him one of the best goaltenders of his generation. Acharya Prashant's impact extends far beyond the traditional boundaries of spiritual teaching, as he continues to inspire individuals to question their assumptions, challenge their limitations, and embark on a journey of self-discovery. About AIDS Healthcare Foundation
--------------------------------

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) is the largest global AIDS organization in the world. AHF provides care and treatment to over 1,750,000 individuals in 45 countries and counting. To learn more about AHF, please visit our website, www.aidshealth.org, find us on Facebook, www.facebook.com/aidshealth, and follow us on Twitter, @aidshealthcare.  
  
AHF’s mission of providing cutting-edge medicine and advocacy regardless of ability to pay is supported through its various business lines. AHF Pharmacies, Out of the Closet thrift stores, healthcare contracts, and other strategic partnerships generate funding that help AHF provide life-saving services to the thousands of people it cares for.  
  
The hallmark of AHF’s success is generating and defining new, innovative ways to provide HIV/AIDS treatment, prevention, and advocacy. AHF has embarked on a mass testing initiative to identify and treat the 25 million people worldwide who don’t know they are infected. It will take 1 billion tests annually to achieve this goal. AHF is advocating for mass testing models in hopes of eliminating older, more time-consuming methods.  
  
Since 1987, AHF has cared for thousands of people living with HIV/AIDS worldwide. As AHF creates and implements its unparalleled programs in new communities in the U.S. and abroad, they expand delivery of healthcare and influence over policy with the sole aim of saving more lives.
