With his undeniable talent, mesmerizing screen presence, and dedication to his craft, Howard has become one of the most respected and sought-after actors in Hollywood.  
  
Born on March 11, 1969, in Chicago, Illinois, Howard developed a passion for acting at an early age. This passion led him to pursue a career in the industry, and after studying at the Pratt Institute in New York City, he honed his skills at various theater productions. Howard soon caught the attention of casting directors and landed his first major film role in 1995's "Dead Presidents," directed by the Hughes brothers. His performance in the film showcased his natural talent and marked the beginning of a career filled with outstanding performances.  
  
One of Howard's most notable roles came in 2004 when he portrayed Quentin, a morally conflicted DJ, in the critically acclaimed film "Crash." The film tackled the complexities of race and social issues in America, earning widespread recognition and praise. Howard's portrayal of Quentin was deeply moving and earned him an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor. This nomination catapulted him into the esteemed circle of actors recognized for their outstanding contributions to the industry.  
  
In addition to "Crash," Howard has delivered countless outstanding performances in various genres. One of his most memorable roles was as Djay in the 2005 film "Hustle & Flow." As a struggling rapper trying to make a name for himself, Howard's portrayal was nothing short of mesmerizing. He effortlessly captured the raw emotions and hardships faced by his character, ultimately winning the hearts of viewers and earning an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor. The film's standout song, "It's Hard Out Here for a Pimp," became an anthem and garnered Howard and his fellow cast members an Academy Award for Best Original Song.  
  
Howard's acting range extends beyond dramatic roles, as he has proven his versatility by delving into various genres. In 2008, he starred in the superhero film "Iron Man" as Lieutenant Colonel James "Rhodey" Rhodes, a staunch ally to the film's protagonist, Tony Stark. Howard's portrayal of Rhodey showcased his ability to bring depth and charisma to a character, even in a more mainstream, action-filled film. While he did not reprise the role in subsequent installments of the franchise, his portrayal left a lasting impression on audiences worldwide.  
  
In addition to his film work, Terrence Howard has also made a significant impact on television. In 2015, he took on the role of Lucious Lyon, the enigmatic and complex patriarch of the Lyon family in the hit television series "Empire." Howard's portrayal of Lucious garnered critical acclaim and won him a Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Actor in a Drama Series. His performance as a music mogul navigating personal and professional challenges captivated audiences and helped make "Empire" a standout television series.  
  
Terrence Howard's talent and dedication to his craft have earned him numerous awards and accolades throughout his career. However, his journey has not been without its challenges. Behind the scenes, he has faced personal hardships, which he has openly shared with the public. In interviews, Howard has spoken about his turbulent childhood, his struggles with addiction, and his lifelong battle to find his place in the world. These personal experiences have undoubtedly shaped his approach to acting, allowing him to tap into deep wells of emotion and portray characters with authenticity and vulnerability.  
  
Beyond his acting abilities, Howard is also a skilled musician and songwriter. He has released several albums throughout his career, showcasing his talents as a vocalist and songwriter. His passion for music has often intersected with his work as an actor, as he has contributed original songs to various film and television projects.  
  
In conclusion, Terrence Howard is a force to be reckoned with in the world of American acting. His ability to captivate audiences with his nuanced performances, his versatility across various genres, and his dedication to his craft make him a true standout in the industry. From his breakthrough role in "Dead Presidents" to his mesmerizing portrayals in "Crash," "Hustle & Flow," and "Empire," Howard continues to push the boundaries of his artistry. With each new project, he reminds us why he is hailed as one of the most talented and respected actors of his generation.

About Seacoast Business Funding
-------------------------------

Seacoast Business Funding develops customized working capital solutions across a broad range of industries (including staffing, manufacturing, distribution, healthcare, government receivables, food & beverage, and business services) through the utilization of Accounts Receivable Financing, Invoice Factoring, and Asset-Based Lending.  
  
Our unique combination of extensive industry expertise, access to a stable source of funding through our affiliation with Seacoast Bank, and a relationship-based approach enables us to forge true partnerships with our clients.  
  
Accounts Receivable Financing  
Allows businesses to fund against their outstanding invoices, outsource their credit and provides a built-in revolving line of credit. Factoring is a complete financial solution that combines credit management, working capital financing, accounts receivable management and collection assistance.  
  
Asset-Based Lending  
Provides businesses with immediate funds and ongoing cash flow in the form of a revolving line of credit based upon a percentage of the value of the company’s assets, such as commercial accounts receivable and inventory.  
  
Partner with Us!

What financing solutions does Seacoast Business Funding offer?

How does Invoice Factoring work?

Invoice Factoring is a financing method where a business sells its accounts receivable (invoices) to Seacoast Business Funding at a discount. This allows the business to receive immediate cash instead of waiting for customers to pay their invoices. The funding company then collects the payments directly from the customers. This solution is particularly beneficial for businesses that need quick access to cash to cover expenses or invest in opportunities.

What is Accounts Receivable Financing and how is it different from Invoice Factoring?

Accounts Receivable Financing is a type of funding where businesses use their accounts receivable as collateral to secure a loan or line of credit. Unlike Invoice Factoring, where the receivables are sold, in Accounts Receivable Financing, the business retains ownership of the invoices and is responsible for collecting payments. This option is ideal for businesses looking for a flexible financing solution while maintaining control over their customer relationships.

About Coborn's, Inc.
--------------------

Coborn's, Inc., headquartered in Saint Cloud, Minnesota, is a dynamic and rapidly expanding employee-owned grocery retailer that serves communities throughout the Midwest. With a diverse array of grocery store formats, including Coborn's, Cash Wise, Marketplace Foods, Tadych's Marketplace Foods, and Hornbacher's, the company caters to a wide range of customer needs. Coborn's, Inc. has embraced the digital age by offering innovative online grocery home delivery services through its CobornsDelivers and Cash Wise Delivers platforms, ensuring convenience for busy shoppers.  
  
In addition to its grocery operations, Coborn's, Inc. operates a variety of liquor stores under brands such as Coborn's Liquor, Cash Wise Liquor, Andy's Liquor, and Captain Jack's, providing customers with a comprehensive selection of beverages. The company's fuel and convenience division, along with its in-house grocery warehouse and distribution center, enhances its operational efficiency and product availability. The in-house Central Bakery produces fresh baked goods, while Tops Cleaners offers laundry services, further diversifying the company's service offerings.  
  
Coborn's, Inc. also strategically partners with other retail entities, including Little Dukes, Holiday Stationstores, Ace Hardware, Caribou Coffee, Dunn Bros Coffee, Erbert & Gerbert's, and Subway, to enhance its market presence and provide customers with a one-stop shopping experience. By leveraging technology and a commitment to quality, Coborn's, Inc. continues to thrive in the competitive grocery industry, focusing on customer satisfaction and community engagement.

About Amy Schumer

Amy Schumer is an American comedian and actress who has risen to fame with her bold, unapologetic humor and relatable storytelling. Known for her sharp wit and fearless approach to sensitive topics, Schumer has become a trailblazer in the world of comedy, breaking down barriers and challenging societal norms with her unique brand of humor.  
  
Born in 1981 in New York City, Schumer discovered her passion for comedy at a young age. Influenced by the likes of Lucille Ball, Gilda Radner, and Carol Burnett, she pursued her dream relentlessly and eventually landed her first stand-up gig in 2004. From there, Schumer's career skyrocketed, earning her praise and recognition for her hilarious and unabashedly honest performances.  
  
Schumer's comedy routines often touch on taboo subjects such as relationships, body image, and sex, but it's her ability to transform personal anecdotes into universal experiences that truly sets her apart. With a sharp eye for observation, she fearlessly tackles society's double standards and challenges sexism, providing a voice for women everywhere. Her ability to balance vulgarity and vulnerability has won over audiences globally, earning her a dedicated fan base.  
  
In addition to her stand-up career, Schumer has made a name for herself in the acting world. In 2012, she starred in her own sketch comedy series, "Inside Amy Schumer," which quickly became a hit. The show featured a mix of stand-up, sketches, and interviews, showcasing Schumer's versatility as a performer. Along with her comedic chops, she demonstrated a knack for social commentary, shedding light on issues such as body shaming, gender inequality, and consent.  
  
Schumer's success continued to grow with her breakout performance in the 2015 film "Trainwreck," which she also wrote. The film garnered critical acclaim, earning Schumer a nomination for the prestigious Writers Guild of America Award for Best Original Screenplay. Her portrayal of a commitment-phobic journalist struck a chord with audiences, and she effortlessly showcased her acting abilities alongside A-list actors.  
  
Beyond her stand-up and acting career, Schumer has also used her platform as a means of activism, advocating for issues close to her heart. She has been a vocal supporter of gun control, sharing her personal connection to a deadly shooting at a screening of her film "Trainwreck." Through her powerful storytelling, she has shed light on the devastating impact of gun violence in America, becoming a voice for change in a highly polarized debate.  
  
Schumer's influence extends far beyond the entertainment industry. With her wit and candor, she has become a role model for women everywhere, championing body positivity and self-acceptance. She frequently embraces her own imperfections, combating society's relentless pursuit of perfection by emphasizing the importance of self-love and confidence.  
  
Despite her success, Schumer has not been immune to criticism and controversy. Her comedy often pushes boundaries, and not everyone appreciates her irreverent style. However, she remains unfazed by the naysayers, remaining true to herself and using her platform to advocate for the issues she believes in.  
  
In a world where comedy can be divisive and challenging to navigate, Amy Schumer stands out as a force to be reckoned with. Her fearlessness and honesty have earned her a place in the hearts of millions, and her impact on the comedy world and beyond is undeniable. Whether she's performing on stage, starring in films, or using her platform for activism, Schumer continues to inspire and entertain audiences with her unique blend of humor and social commentary.

Mark Baza has been at the helm of the Imperial County Transportation Commission (ICTC) since May 2010, where he has played a pivotal role in shaping the region's transportation landscape. His expertise in urban and rural planning, coupled with a strong foundation in land development and goods movement, has enabled him to spearhead key projects that enhance mobility and accessibility for residents.  
  
One of Baza's notable initiatives includes the development of comprehensive transit plans that integrate public transport with pedestrian planning, promoting a more interconnected and user-friendly transportation system. His strategic vision has fostered public/private partnerships that leverage resources and expertise, driving innovative solutions to improve transit services. Additionally, Baza has been instrumental in conducting feasibility studies and navigating zoning and entitlement processes, ensuring that transportation projects align with local government objectives and community aspirations.  
  
With a Bachelor of Arts in Urban & Rural Studies/Planning from the University of California, San Diego, Baza combines academic knowledge with practical experience, making him a respected figure in the field of transportation planning. His commitment to enhancing the quality of life in Imperial County through effective transportation solutions reflects his dedication to public service and community engagement. As he continues to lead ICTC, Baza remains focused on advancing projects that not only meet current transportation needs but also anticipate future demands in an ever-evolving landscape.

Oh's influence extends beyond the screen, inspiring audiences to embrace their unique identities and celebrating the nuances of their culture.  
  
In conclusion, Sandra Oh has captivated audiences with her exceptional talent, versatility, and dedication to her craft. Founded in 1800 and set in the beautiful Champlain Valley of Vermont, Middlebury College has long been one of the finest liberal arts colleges in the country. Middlebury is a nationally recognized academic institution that encompasses a liberal arts undergraduate college, 38 Schools Abroad programs, 11 summer immersion Language Schools, the Bread Loaf School of English, the Bread Loaf Writers'​ Conference, School of the Environment, as well as the Middlebury Institute of International Studies at Monterey—all with a shared institutional goal of doing the highest quality work for positive and global impact.  
  
With year-round operations on five continents, our employees are one of our most valuable assets, and we are committed to the success and development of our workforce. Our employees enjoy an engaging lifestyle with excellent compensation, as well as competitive benefits (health, dental, life, disability, retirement, and vision) and educational assistance programs.  
  
Middlebury College is an equal-opportunity employer where diversity, equity, and inclusion are core values. To this end, the College recruits talented and diverse faculty, staff, and students from across the United States and around the world. Middlebury College encourages applications from women, people of color, people with disabilities, and members of other protected classes and historically underrepresented communities. The College also invites applications from individuals who demonstrate an ongoing commitment to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

About Matheny Medical and Educational Center
--------------------------------------------

Matheny’s mission is to provide exceptional care and an optimal quality of life for children and adults with special needs and medically complex developmental disabilities.  
  
Overview  
Matheny is a special hospital for children and adults with medically complex developmental disabilities . . . a special education school providing academics, combined with functional life skills, for students, ages 3-21 . . . and a comprehensive outpatient center meeting the health care needs of people with all types of disabilities in the community. Matheny also trains healthcare professionals, therapists and educators in how to work effectively with persons who have developmental disabilities.  
  
Matheny’s main campus in Peapack, NJ, is home to 100 children and adults with developmental disabilities. Its five group homes, located in Somerset and Warren counties, provide a residence in the community for an additional 30 adults. Many of the children and adults currently at Matheny, in addition to their primary diagnoses, have a long list of associated clinical conditions such as vision and hearing deficits, seizure disorders, mental retardation and dysphagia, with resulting aspiration problems.  
  
While the great majority of Matheny patients have cerebral palsy as their primary diagnoses, Matheny also has patients with spina bifida, Lesch-Nyhan Disease (LND) and a wide range of uncommon conditions including Rett syndrome, Angelman syndrome, Cornelia De Lange syndrome, Wolf-Hirshorn syndrome and 4Q Deletion syndrome. Lesch-Nyhan Disease is a rare x-linked recessive disorder associated with cognitive impairment, high levels of uric acid in the blood, kidney involvement and the hallmark symptom — severe and involuntary self-injurious behaviors. Matheny is recognized as the leading source of information on care issues regarding LND.

About Universidad Católica de Valencia San Vicente Mártir
---------------------------------------------------------

Nacida del corazón de la Iglesia valentina, la Universidad Católica de Valencia “San Vicente Mártir” se revela como un centro incomparable de creatividad y de irradiación del saber para el bien de la sociedad. Fruto de la labor universitaria desempeñada durante más de cincuenta años por la Escuela Universitaria de Enfermería "Ntra. Sra. de los Desamparados", más de treinta por la Fundación Edetania y más de diez por la Facultad de Estudios de la Empresa, la Universidad Católica busca, al mismo tiempo, una exigente calidad de vida universitaria: el trabajo conjunto entre la fe y la razón; el fortalecimiento de una auténtica comunidad universitaria en un clima de amistad académica; y el propósito de crear y mantener con los universitarios una relación educativa singularmente personalizada. La UCV cuenta con 15 sedes situadas en el centro de Valencia y alrededores: Godella, Burjassot, Torrent, Alzira, Carcaixent y Xátiva, en las que se cursan 22 títulos oficiales de grado, 21 másteres oficiales y 14 propios, en un total de 8 facultades.

About Ken Paxton

Ken Paxton is a prominent figure in Texas politics, serving as the state's Attorney General since 2015. With a background in law and a reputation for staunch conservatism, Paxton has been at the forefront of numerous legal battles on behalf of the Lone Star State. His role as the chief lawyer and legal advisor to the state government has allowed him to make significant contributions and shape the direction of Texas politics on key issues such as governance, healthcare, and immigration.  
  
Born and raised in Minot, North Dakota, Paxton relocated to Texas after completing law school at the University of Virginia. He quickly gained recognition as an attorney, specializing in business and corporate law, and later co-founded his own law firm in McKinney, Texas. Paxton's conservative values and dedication to defending religious freedoms caught the attention of voters, leading him to pursue a career in public service.  
  
As Texas Attorney General, Paxton has become known for his unwavering commitment to conservative principles and his aggressive pursuit of legal battles seen as defending the Texas way of life. One of his earliest and most notable legal challenges came when he led a coalition of states to challenge the constitutionality of the Affordable Care Act, commonly known as Obamacare. Paxton argued that the individual mandate, which required individuals to obtain health insurance, was an overreach of federal power. While the case ultimately made its way to the United States Supreme Court, resulting in a ruling largely upholding the law, Paxton's efforts solidified his reputation as a fierce advocate for limited government.  
  
In addition to his battles against federal overreach, Paxton has also taken on contentious issues within Texas. One of his key priorities has been securing the state's elections, leading to increased efforts to combat voter fraud. He has relentlessly pursued cases of voter fraud, often resulting in convictions and increased scrutiny of the voting process. Paxton's efforts in this area have been both praised for their commitment to election integrity and criticized for disproportionately targeting minority communities and creating unnecessary roadblocks to voting.  
  
Another significant aspect of Paxton's tenure as Texas Attorney General has been his involvement in defending the state's conservative agenda. He has played a vital role in supporting and defending controversial policies, such as the controversial "bathroom bill," which aimed to restrict bathroom access for transgender individuals. Despite its failure to pass, Paxton displayed unwavering support for the legislation, arguing that it was necessary to protect the privacy and safety of Texans. His position on social issues has earned him both praise from conservatives and fierce opposition from liberals who accuse him of promoting discriminatory policies.  
  
However, Paxton's time in office has not been without controversy. In 2020, allegations of securities fraud emerged against him, leading to a criminal indictment. The charges claimed that Paxton had misled investors in a technology startup in which he was an investor. Despite the legal challenges, Paxton has maintained his innocence and continues to fulfill his duties as Attorney General. The case remains ongoing, with its outcome yet to be determined, leaving a cloud of uncertainty hanging over his political future.  
  
In summary, Ken Paxton's role as Texas Attorney General has been characterized by his fierce and unapologetic defense of conservative principles and the values of the Lone Star State. His legal battles against federal overreach, dedication to election integrity, and his involvement in controversial policies have made him a divisive figure in Texas politics. With ongoing legal challenges and an uncertain future, only time will tell how Paxton's tenure will be remembered in the annals of Texas history.

D-Orbit is a global market leader in the space logistics and transportation service industries with a track record of space-proven technologies and successful missions. D-Orbit was founded in 2011. With a manifest of future missions fully booked by new and returning customers, the company has already successfully flown over 70 payloads. D-Orbit is the first company to address the logistics needs of the space market. Its forward-thinking view has enabled it to consistently create solutions for its customers that save them money and time, like ION Satellite Carrier, a vehicle that can transport satellites in orbit and release them individually into distinct orbital slots, and a proprietary cloud-based mission control software suite designed to control entire satellite constellations.  
  
As it looks to the future, D-Orbit is already developing and testing new technologies to extend the life of satellites in orbit, perform active debris removal, enable interplanetary space logistics, and more. About SweetWater Brewing Company
--------------------------------

The first brewery for SweetWater was off of Fulton Industrial Boulevard, on Atlanta’s west side and opened our doors on February 17th, 1997.  
  
SweetWater’s second and current location is in Midtown Atlanta, adjacent to Ansley Park, in the Armour Circle Industrial Park just off of Piedmont and Monroe. This new building is 115,000 square feet of brewing goodness and smack in the middle of all the action.  
  
Since the brewery began we’ve wanted to be closer to our homes, the bars and stores that sell our beer, and all the good folks that drink it. Fortunately seven years of great growth gave us that opportunity. We learned a lot from that location and left all those mistakes behind as we built our new home. We have been here since 2004 and it feels good to be settled in.  
  
Our new home has enough capacity to brew 420,000 barrels of beer a year, but hopefully it'll be a few more years before we start feeling the walls getting tight again.  
  
SweetWater holds tours and tastings weekly on Thursday's and Friday between 4:20 and 9 Saturday 11 - 10 & Sundays 12:30 - 7pm. SweetWater is also open for private events throughout the week.

About Ritter Sport
------------------

Ritter Sport was founded in 1912 as a venture of business & love by Alfred & Clara Ritter. With their chocolate and confectionery factory in Stuttgart, they laid the cornerstone for Ritter Sport’s chocolate history. By 1930, their success beckoned a need for more space so the company moved to idyllic Waldenbuch. Two years later, in 1932, Clara came up with the idea to produce a square chocolate bar so it wouldn’t break in the pockets of sport jackets. With ever increasing new varieties, the company continued to gain more chocolate fans.  
  
Today, Ritter Sport is a strong, medium-sized, family-owned company loved in Germany and around the world. Top taste is discussed alongside sustainability. As of 2018, Ritter Sport sources 100% exclusively certified sustainable cocoa for its entire assortment. No matter what comes in the future, two things will remain: family tradition & love for good chocolate. Alfred Theodor Ritter and his sister Marli Hoppe-Ritter, grandchildren of the founders, now represent the family company in its third generation.

About Art Institute Of Chicago
------------------------------

The Art Institute of Chicago, founded in 1879, is a world-renowned art museum housing one of the largest permanent collections in the United States. An encyclopedic museum, the Art Institute collects, preserves, and interprets works in every medium from all cultures and historical periods. With a collection of approximately 300,000 art works and artifacts, the museum has particularly strong holdings in Impressionist and Post-Impressionist painting, contemporary art, early 20th century European painting and sculpture, Japanese prints, and photography. The museum’s 2009 addition, the Modern Wing, features the latest in green museum technology and 264,000 square feet dedicated to modern and contemporary art, photography, architecture and design, and new museum education facilities. In addition to displaying its permanent collection, the Art Institute mounts more than 30 special exhibitions per year and features lectures, gallery tours, and special performances on a daily basis.

About Ian Rankin

Ian Rankin is a renowned Scottish crime writer best known for his Inspector Rebus series. Born on April 28, 1960, in Cardenden, Fife, Rankin has become one of the most successful and respected writers in the crime fiction genre. His books have been translated into over 30 languages and have sold millions of copies worldwide.  
  
Rankin studied English Literature at the University of Edinburgh, where he developed a deep appreciation for literature and storytelling. It was during his time at university that Rankin became interested in crime fiction, and he began to experiment with writing in the genre. After graduating, he held various odd jobs and worked as a grape-picker in France before he eventually stumbled into a career in writing.  
  
Rankin's breakthrough came in 1987 when his first Rebus novel, "Knots and Crosses," was published. The book introduced the world to Inspector John Rebus, a flawed and complex detective who would go on to become the central character in a series of bestselling novels. With this debut, Rankin established himself as a talented and skilled writer, and he quickly gained a loyal and devoted readership.  
  
One of the reasons why Rankin's novels have captivated readers for so long is his ability to create rich and authentic characters. Inspector Rebus, in particular, has been praised for his depth and complexity. He is a compelling and relatable protagonist who is not afraid to confront the darker aspects of human nature. Rankin's portrayal of Edinburgh also plays a crucial role in the success of his novels. The city comes to life in his books, serving as a vivid and atmospheric backdrop to the gripping mysteries and intricate plotlines.  
  
In addition to his masterful character development and evocative setting, Rankin is also known for his sharp and incisive writing style. He has a knack for crafting intelligent and nuanced narratives that keep readers on the edge of their seats. His intricate plots are filled with unexpected twists and turns, and his prose is both lyrical and engaging. Rankin's writing is not only entertaining but also thought-provoking, as he often explores social and political issues within the framework of his crime fiction.  
  
Over the years, Rankin has received numerous awards and accolades for his contributions to the crime fiction genre. He has won the Crime Writers' Association's Dagger in the Library Award, the Diamond Dagger for Lifetime Achievement, and the Theakston's Old Peculier Crime Novel of the Year Award, among others. In 2002, he was also honored with an OBE for his services to literature.  
  
Even after achieving worldwide success, Rankin has continued to write and publish new works at a prolific pace. His dedication to his craft and his commitment to delivering high-quality storytelling have solidified his reputation as one of the most influential and beloved writers of his generation. His novels have not only entertained readers but have also left a lasting impact on the crime fiction genre as a whole.  
  
In addition to his novels, Rankin has also written short stories, non-fiction, and standalone works, further showcasing his versatility as a writer. He has also been involved in various television and radio projects, and his influence extends beyond the page. His contributions to the world of literature have been recognized by his peers and readers alike, cementing his status as a literary icon.  
  
In conclusion, Ian Rankin is a literary powerhouse whose impact on the crime fiction genre cannot be overstated. With his compelling characters, evocative settings, and masterful storytelling, he has earned a place among the greatest writers of our time. His work continues to captivate and inspire readers, and his influence will undoubtedly endure for many years to come.

About Macaulay Business Club
----------------------------

The Macaulay Business Club (MBC) is the largest and oldest student organization of the City University of New York's (CUNY) Macaulay Honors College, dedicated to the professional development of all CUNY students.  
  
MBC focuses on 3 key areas:  
  
1) Event Coordination: Each semester, we host various events such as panel presentations, networking conferences and galas, and company tours. In addition to our own events, we also partner with a myriad of external and internal organizations to bring amazing events to all students.  
  
2) Content Creation: Our team produces articles and videos dedicated to various topics in business. We aim to inform students about current events, provide insight on the various industries, and provide advice on how to pursue their career goals.  
  
3) Curation: We inform students about resources and opportunities that are readily available to advance their professional development.  
  
MBC continues to implement new initiatives. Feel free to contact us for more information. You can also follow us on social media (Facebook and Instagram) to stay up to date on our initiatives and opportunities, or e-mail us at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

His dedication to meticulous research, combined with his talent for crafting compelling narratives, has solidified his status as a leading voice in the exploration and interpretation of military history. About Michael Aram
------------------

Michael Aram is an award-winning American artist who has dedicated his career to craft-based design. Inspired by a trip to India at age 25, he established a second home and workshop there, where he continues to draw creative inspiration. Although best known for his work in metal, Aram works across all materials with a focus on objects made by hand.  
  
Trained as a painter, sculptor, and art historian, Aram has neatly applied his creative background to objects ranging from the fine and decorative arts to jewelry. His often lyrical work is inspired by nature, his biggest muse, as well as his love of the making process. Aram crafts pieces that have a personal connection to him and which speak to his love of symbolism, nature, narrative storytelling, and objects made by hand.  
  
Aram’s work is as artistically original as it is a celebration of age-old handcrafted traditions. The enduring fusion of these ideals- originality, storyline, and craftsmanship- that have become the hallmark of this gifted artist.  
  
Making things by hand is the core of our brand. Today, over 200 skilled artisans work alongside Aram. Whether from his studio in New York City or India, Aram’s attention to detail and creative passion is constant whether he is creating a one of a kind sculpture, a piece of jewelry, or a decorative object. He feels there is a ‘vibration’ in objects made by hand that is expressed through the immediacy of the making process. Organic shapes made by hand create ‘perfectly imperfect’ pieces, which Aram maintains are a reflection of our own humanity.  
  
Motifs are central to Michael’s work as he is highly inspired by his surroundings and often represents objects that have meaning for him, especially those that might otherwise be overlooked in the everyday. Nature is his biggest source of inspiration, as is the handmade process.

We're proud to offer our exclusive collection of children's furniture, bedding, decor and accessories at potterybarnkids.com and in more than 90 stores in the US and abroad. From the nursery to the playroom, our collections make it easy to make your house a home.

We believe kids' rooms should be every bit as beautiful, stylish and personal as grown-up spaces. After all, they're setting the stage for some of life's most precious moments, from walking to talking. Every parent wants to feel good about what they put into their kids' rooms, so we're dedicated to creating collections that are safe and sound. We also provide a large collection of 100% cotton organic bedding.  
  
Our Designs:  
Each of our collections and collaborations draw upon our comfortable, casual aesthetic, and are expertly crafted from the best of materials with an eye for child safety standards. The Tennessee Titans are a prominent professional football team competing in the National Football League (NFL), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. Established in 1960 as the Houston Oilers, the franchise was a founding member of the American Football League (AFL) and transitioned to the NFL during the AFL-NFL merger in 1970. The team made a significant move in 1997, relocating to Tennessee and subsequently opening their home stadium, Nissan Stadium, in downtown Nashville in 1999.  
  
The Titans are deeply rooted in the sports and entertainment industry, providing thrilling live football experiences and engaging fan interactions. They serve a diverse audience, from passionate local supporters to national fans, offering a range of services including game-day experiences, merchandise sales, and community outreach programs. The organization is committed to leveraging technology to enhance fan engagement, utilizing advanced analytics for player performance, and implementing cutting-edge stadium technologies to improve the overall spectator experience.  
  
As a key player in the NFL, the Titans are dedicated to excellence both on and off the field, striving for success in every season while fostering a strong sense of community. Their commitment to innovation and fan engagement positions them as a leading franchise in professional sports, making them a vital part of Nashville's cultural landscape. With a rich history and a bright future, the Tennessee Titans continue to inspire and entertain football fans across the nation.

About Japan Exchange and Teaching Program(me) (JET)
---------------------------------------------------

The Japan Exchange and Teaching (JET) Programme, founded in 1987, is aimed at promoting grass-roots international exchange between Japan and other nations. The number of countries sending participants has risen over the years, as has the number of participants. In 2022, the Programme welcomed 5,723 participants from 50 countries.  
The JET Programme enables local authorities (prefectures, designated cities and other municipalities) to employ foreign youth for the purpose of improving foreign language education as well as promoting international exchange at the local level. CLAIR administers the JET Programme in cooperation with the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), and the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT).  
Three types of jobs are offered on the Programme: Assistant Language Teacher (ALT) who are assigned to local boards of education or schools (elementary, junior and senior high) and carry out their duties under the guidance of Japanese Teachers of foreign language. Coordinator for International Relations (CIRs) are placed in the offices of local authorities or related organisations and engage in internationalisation activities under the guidance of a contracting organisations. Sports Exchange Advisors (SEAs) are placed in local authorities engage in sports-related activities and are involved in internationalisation activities through the instruction of specific sports.

Tech Team Foundations: We help you get your product off the ground by shipping clean code using reliable, established processes as you scale your team.  
  
Infrastructure Setup: We provide you with lean, cloud-based infrastructure and distributed systems to match your scaling needs.  
  
We believe that relationships with clients should go beyond exchanging money for services. That’s why we value open communication, collaboration, transparency, and quality deliverables.

Welcome to KDN Shanghai, where we are hard at work every day to replace traditional industrial processes with sustainable, environmentally-friendly and more innovative solutions. We owe it to the earth to do so.  
KDN Biotech is a leading enzyme company that specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of high-quality enzymes for a variety of industries, including textile, household care, bioenergy, pulp & paper, animal nutrition, food enzyme. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, KDN Biotech has earned a reputation as a trusted supplier of enzymes that meet the most demanding standards.  
  
Founded by a team of experienced scientists and entrepreneurs, KDN Biotech has 9 production bases, 8 technical centers, 2 laboratories, 32 Ph.Ds and about 300 Masters.  
This has enabled the company to develop a broad range of enzymes that can be customized to meet the specific needs of its customers.  
  
KDN Biotech's product portfolio includes a wide range of enzymes, including proteases, lipases, cellulase and specialty enzymes.  
  
At KDN Biotech, we are committed to sustainability and responsible manufacturing practices. Our enzymes are produced using eco-friendly processes and are derived from non-GMO sources. We strive to minimize our environmental impact and promote a sustainable future for all.

About Greektown Casino-Hotel
----------------------------

Greektown Casino-Hotel offers more than the everyday visit to its guests, it offers an experience. The property boasts a 400-room, 30-story hotel with gorgeous views of the Detroit River and Canada. Within the hotel are contemporary two – or three – room suites, a fitness center, a business center, a restaurant and bar overlooking the hotel lobby and a sports bar – all connected to the casino via skywalk. The property’s 100,000-square-foot gaming floor offers more than 2,500 of the latest slots and table games, as well as a live Poker Room.  
  
Greektown Casino-Hotel's super pit table game area is home to all your favorite table games in one lucky place - The Fringe Video Poker bar, featuring large flat screens to watch your favorite Detroit sports team, and Asteria lounge, the former Opa Bar that boasts large lounge chairs to gather with friends, a Video Poker bar, live entertainment, and eatery. Greektown Casino-Hotel recently unveiled its own award winning signature restaurant Brizola, located right off the casino floor.  
  
Located in the heart of Detroit’s Greektown Entertainment District, full of energy and rich tradition, the property affords its guests the opportunity to delve in over thirty tempting dining and entertainment options, from high-end restaurants to high energy bars, all within walking distance. Want to catch a play, concert, or a game? The Gem Theatre, Music Hall, Tiger Stadium and Ford Field are just steps away from the property’s front door.  
  
Greektown plays hosts to events that include conferences, small and large meetings, family reunions, weddings and trade shows. Groups and event planners alike praise the property for its one-of-a-kind customer service and affordability – all major factors in insuring a successful group program. In addition, with the close proximity of the People Mover – it literally stops inside the property – guests can visit all of Detroit’s hot spots.

Foxx's breakthrough as a bona fide movie star occurred in 2004, when he portrayed iconic musician Ray Charles in the biographical film "Ray." This transformative role not only showcased Foxx's remarkable acting prowess, but it also allowed the world to witness his exceptional dedication to his craft. Foxx underwent an intensive six-month transformation, mastering Charles' unique mannerisms, musical style, and even learning to play the piano with accuracy. His ability to seamlessly transition between intense drama and light-hearted comedy solidified his reputation as one of the most talented actors of his generation.  
  
Despite his success in film and television, Jamie Foxx never forgot his roots as a comedian. He continued to perform stand-up, mesmerizing audiences with his sharp wit and relatable humor. His comedy specials, such as "I Might Need Security" and "Jamie Foxx: Straight from the Foxxhole," showcased his ability to connect with audiences on a personal level, touching upon a range of topics with thoughtfulness, intelligence, and hilarious anecdotes from his own life.  
  
Foxx's exceptional talent extended beyond his performances onscreen. He displayed a deep commitment to humanitarian efforts, using his platform to create positive change in the world. Following Hurricane Katrina, Foxx played a pivotal role in organizing and participating in the "America: A Tribute to Heroes" telethon, which raised millions of dollars for disaster relief. Additionally, he remains actively involved in various philanthropic endeavors, including youth mentorship programs and advocating for social justice issues.  
  
In conclusion, Jamie Foxx has undoubtedly left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. His exceptional talent as an actor, comedian, and musician has garnered critical acclaim and a loyal fanbase. Foxx's undeniable magnetism, coupled with his versatility and dedication to his craft, have solidified his status as a true Hollywood icon. With his extraordinary career trajectory and unwavering commitment to excellence, Foxx continues to inspire and entertain audiences worldwide.

About Vince Carter

Vince Carter - American Former Basketball Shooting Guard  
  
Vince Carter, an American former professional basketball shooting guard, captivated audiences and left an indelible mark on the sport. Known for his electrifying dunks, smooth shooting stroke, and longevity in the game, Carter's career spanned an impressive 22 seasons, making him one of the greatest shooting guards in NBA history.  
  
Born Vincent Lamar Carter Jr. on January 26, 1977, in Daytona Beach, Florida, basketball was deeply ingrained in his DNA. Raised in a family with a rich basketball tradition, Carter excelled in the sport from a young age. His high school career at Mainland High School showcased his immense talent and earned him a spot in the McDonald's All-American Game.  
  
After his high school success, Carter attended the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (UNC). During his time there, he played alongside future NBA superstars such as Antawn Jamison and Jerry Stackhouse. In his sophomore season, Carter's explosive style of play captured the attention of fans and scouts alike. He led the Tar Heels to the Final Four and was named the ACC Player of the Year.  
  
In 1998, Carter declared for the NBA Draft, where he was selected fifth overall by the Golden State Warriors and immediately traded to the Toronto Raptors. He quickly became the face of the franchise, enthralling fans with his high-flying dunks that earned him the nickname "Air Canada." Carter's breathtaking athleticism showcased the beauty of the game, and he quickly became a fan favorite across the league.  
  
During his time in Toronto, Carter had several iconic moments, including winning the 2000 Slam Dunk Contest with an unforgettable display of creativity and athleticism. His style of play, charisma, and marketability popularized basketball in Canada, leaving a lasting impact on the sport's growth north of the border.  
  
In 2004, Carter was traded to the New Jersey Nets, where he continued to showcase his scoring prowess. With the Nets, he teamed up with fellow star Jason Kidd, forming a formidable duo that led the team to great success, including multiple playoff runs. Carter's smooth shooting stroke, combined with his ability to attack the rim, made him a constant scoring threat and a headache for opposing defenses.  
  
After his stint with the Nets, Carter embarked on a journeyman phase of his career, playing for several teams, including the Orlando Magic, Phoenix Suns, Dallas Mavericks, Memphis Grizzlies, Sacramento Kings, and Atlanta Hawks. Despite changing teams, Carter's impact remained significant. He embraced a veteran role, mentoring younger players and providing leadership both on and off the court. His ability to adapt his game to different roles showcased his basketball IQ and professionalism.  
  
In 2019, at the age of 42, Carter became the first player in NBA history to play 22 seasons. His longevity in the game was a testament to his dedication, work ethic, and love for basketball. Carter was not only a great athlete but also a smart player. As age caught up with him and his athleticism declined, he relied on his basketball IQ, experience, and shooting ability to remain effective.  
  
Throughout his illustrious career, Carter achieved numerous accolades. He was an eight-time NBA All-Star, earning the honors in each conference he played. He also won the NBA Slam Dunk Contest in 2000, solidifying his place as one of the greatest dunkers in basketball history. Carter ranks among the top 25 all-time scorers in NBA history and is considered one of the greatest shooting guards of his generation.  
  
Off the court, Carter's impact extended beyond his playing career. Known for his philanthropic efforts, he established the Vince Carter Foundation, supporting education and health initiatives for children. Carter's engagement with the community showcased his commitment to giving back and making a difference in people's lives.  
  
Vince Carter's impact on the game of basketball is immeasurable. His awe-inspiring dunks, consistent scoring ability, and remarkable longevity in the sport cemented his status as one of the all-time great shooting guards. Beyond his on-court success, Carter's charismatic personality, professionalism, and dedication to giving back have left a lasting legacy both in the NBA and in the communities he served.

About Wayne Metro Community Action Agency
-----------------------------------------

MISSION  
In our pursuit to eliminate poverty, Wayne Metro empowers people and communities to be strong, healthy, and thriving.  
  
VISION  
We envision thriving communities where all people have hope and opportunities to realize their full potential.  
  
A BRIEF HISTORY  
Founded in 1971…  
Wayne Metropolitan Community Action Agency (Wayne Metro) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization serving approximately 35,000 low-and moderate-income residents throughout Wayne County. We provide over 60 programs in the areas of Quality Housing, Family Stability and Economic Opportunities. Our services include financial capability education, homeownership workshops, housing counseling, financial counseling, utility assistance, Head Start, GED preparation, free tax preparation, foreclosure prevention and homeless services.  
  
Over the last five decades…  
our Agency budget has grown from just under $1 million to over $40 million while continuing to maintain a low administrative rate of 8%, ensuring at least $0.92 of every funded or donated dollar is utilized for direct client services. Due to our client-centered services and fiscal responsibility, the State of Michigan appointed Wayne Metro as the Interim Communication Action Agency for the City of Detroit in 2013 with the designation becoming permanent in 2015.  
  
Today!  
Wayne Metro supports all of Wayne County with more than 60 programs and over 600 employees. We are proud to serve our community as one of the most forward-thinking Community Action Agencies in the entire country.

About Stitch Fix
----------------

It’s our vision to transform the way people find what they love by combining technology with the creative touch of style experts. The Stitch Fix experience is not merely curated—it’s truly personalized to each client we style. We are committed to inspiring our clients to look, feel and be their best selves.  
  
Founder Katrina Lake created Stitch Fix to blend the human element of personal styling with individually selected clothing and proprietary algorithms. She shipped the first Stitch Fix order (what we call a “Fix”) out of her Cambridge apartment in 2011 while attending Harvard, and today the company has brought convenience and an exclusive shopping experience to millions of men, women and kids throughout the US and UK.  
  
At Stitch Fix, we pride ourselves on personal styling for every one and every body. Our thousands of remote stylists, both in the US and UK, are instrumental in building relationships through Fixes that leverage client feedback and data. The secret to Stitch Fix’s success has been a balance of art and science. Our trusted style partners use our proprietary styling platform to help clients near and far find pieces that fit their lifestyle from everyday occasions to special events. We are building a transformative and inclusive e-commerce model focused on convenience and personal style that makes it radically simple and delightful for customers to discover and buy what they love.  
  
So ‘Why Stitch Fix?’ In addition to all of our benefits and perks, no matter what department you work with, every member plays a part in paving the way we bring the power of personalization to millions while disrupting the retail industry with innovation and tech on our side. Learn more about our story and how we got to where we are today.

About East Alabama Medical Center
---------------------------------

At East Alabama Medical Center, our mission is to provide high quality, compassionate health care. Our core purpose - our mission as an organization - is simple, yet important. We focus on providing the best possible care for every patient, every time, and to do so with empathy, kindness and caring.  
  
In order to achieve our vision of being a national leader in quality, cost and service, EAMC has made a commitment to the continued pursuit of excellence with all of our partners to improve the quality of life for those we serve, to measure our progress against the highest standards in quality of care and quality of service, and to be fiscally responsible with our assets.  
  
EAMC is a 340-bed regional referral hospital located in Opelika, Ala., that serves a six-county area and employs nearly 3,000 employees. EAMC is Lee County’s second largest employer. Among the many services that EAMC and EAMC-Lanier provide are open-heart surgery and cancer treatment, both of which are highly acclaimed specialties at EAMC. EAMC also operates additional services, including RehabWorks, HealthPlus Fitness Center, the Diabetes & Nutrition Center, the Wound Treatment Center, Sleep Disorders Centers and the Auburn University Medical Clinic. EAMC-Lanier has a nursing home, urgent care clinic and occupational medicine program.  
  
For more information, please visit www.eamc.org.

About Nestlé
------------

As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.  
  
We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.  
  
Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.  
  
Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category –offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

What is the Mina Protocol and how does it relate to O(1) Labs?

The Mina Protocol is a lightweight blockchain developed by O(1) Labs that aims to provide a secure and efficient way to access Web3. This allows for greater decentralization and security while utilizing advanced cryptographic techniques, such as zero-knowledge proofs, to ensure privacy and scalability.

O(1) Labs employs advanced cryptographic techniques, particularly zero-knowledge proofs, to enhance the security and privacy of its blockchain solutions. What role does functional programming play in the development of O(1) Labs' technologies?

Functional programming is a core aspect of our development process at O(1) Labs, particularly through our use of the OCaml programming language. About Olivia Jean

Olivia Jean is an American singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist known for her unique blend of rock and roll, garage rock, and surf rock. Hailing from Detroit, Michigan, Jean has established herself as a dynamic and charismatic performer with a sound that draws on a wide range of influences, from 1960s girl groups to classic country and blues. Her music is marked by its raw energy, catchy hooks, and retro-cool vibe, and she has earned a dedicated following for her electrifying live shows and infectious, genre-bending tunes.  
  
Jean's musical journey began at a young age when she picked up the guitar and started writing her own songs. She honed her craft by playing in various bands and immersing herself in the local music scene, drawing inspiration from the rich history of Detroit's musical heritage. In 2009, she joined the all-female garage rock outfit The Black Belles, which became her first major break and brought her to the attention of Third Man Records, the label owned by Jack White. This led to her collaboration with White on her solo debut album, "Bathtub Love Killings," which was released in 2014 to critical acclaim.  
  
"Bathtub Love Killings" showcased Jean's knack for crafting infectious, high-energy rock and roll with a modern twist, and it established her as a formidable talent in her own right. The album's vintage-inspired sound and Jean's magnetic stage presence earned her comparisons to iconic performers like Wanda Jackson and Brenda Lee, and she quickly made a name for herself as a rising star in the indie music scene. With its blend of retro aesthetics and contemporary sensibilities, "Bathtub Love Killings" set the stage for Jean's evolution as an artist who fearlessly blurs the lines between past and present, and tradition and innovation.  
  
In the years that followed, Jean continued to build on her early success, releasing a string of singles and EPs that further showcased her versatility as a songwriter and performer. She also expanded her musical horizons by experimenting with different instruments and styles, embracing a DIY ethos that allowed her to push the boundaries of her sound and explore new sonic territories. Her work caught the attention of audiences and critics alike, and she quickly became known for her willingness to take risks and push herself creatively.  
  
In 2019, Jean released her highly anticipated sophomore album, "Night Owl," which solidified her reputation as an artist who refuses to be confined by genre or convention. With its infectious blend of garage rock, surf rock, and classic pop, "Night Owl" demonstrated Jean's growth as a songwriter and performer, and it showcased her ability to seamlessly blend different influences into a cohesive and compelling sound. The album's lead single, "Garage Bat," became a fan favorite and exemplified Jean's ability to deliver an earworm-worthy hook with plenty of attitude and swagger.  
  
"Night Owl" also marked a turning point in Jean's career, as she began to embrace a more introspective and personal approach to songwriting. The album's lyrics delved into themes of love, loss, and self-discovery, and Jean's emotive delivery added a layer of depth and vulnerability to her music. Tracks like "Shut Your Mouth" and "In The Dark" showcased Jean's introspective side, while "Perfume" and "Rhinestone Love" demonstrated her skill at crafting catchy, anthemic tunes that pack a punch.  
  
Throughout her career, Jean has remained committed to staying true to her roots while also pushing herself to grow and evolve as an artist. Her music is a testament to her passion for rock and roll and her commitment to creating something fresh and exciting, and she continues to captivate audiences with her infectious energy and unapologetic charisma. As she looks ahead to the future, Jean shows no signs of slowing down, and she remains a force to be reckoned with in the world of independent music.  
  
In addition to her musical endeavors, Jean is also a visual artist, and her bold, retro-inspired aesthetic has become an integral part of her persona as an artist. She has also collaborated with a number of other artists and musicians, further solidifying her status as a versatile and talented creative force. With her innate talent, tenacity, and passion for her craft, Olivia Jean is undoubtedly a rising star to watch, and she is poised to make an indelible mark on the music world for years to come.

About Palm Beach International Raceway
--------------------------------------

Palm Beach International Raceway™ (PBIR) is a state-of-the-art, acclaimed motorsports and entertainment facility featuring a challenging 2.034-mile asphalt Road Course, an exciting 1/4-mile concrete Drag Strip, and a thrilling 8/10-mile Kart Track. Approved for Indy Car testing, the 10-turn Road Course at PBIR consists of a 6/10-mile straightaway, 90-foot-wide flex-use area, 40- to 60-foot-wide seamless track, and a 6-degree banked corner. The Road Course welcomes world-class annual events including Formula Drift and the Palm Beach Grand Prix. Designed by former NHRA World Champion Wayne McMurtry, the Drag Strip at PBIR hosts such premier events as the International Hot Rod Association’s Nitro Jam, Pro Winter Warm-Up, 5-Day Citrus Nationals, and Super Chevy Show. Sanctioned by the World Karting Association as a Master Track, the 12-turn, 26-foot-wide Kart Track at PBIR hosts the Florida Winter Tour and conducts karting schools, training courses, 3-hour endurance races, auto crossing events, racing leagues, and “arrive & drive” programs. Driving schools, testing, private rentals, and corporate events are held at PBIR year-round. Founded in 1964 and acquired in 2008 by IRG Sports + Entertainment, PBIR underwent a $20 million remodeling including an upgraded Road Course, low-glare lighting, safety barriers, luxury chalet, VIP trailer and timing tower. Located in Jupiter, FL, PBIR is the home of the Palm Beach Driving Club, MRP Motorsport, and Driven2Win Drag Racing School.

About Colby College Entrepreneurial Alliance
--------------------------------------------

Founded in 1813, Colby College is the 12th oldest liberal arts college in the United States. Distinctive in its offerings, Colby provides an intimate, undergraduate-focused learning environment with a breadth of programs presenting students and faculty with unparalleled opportunities. A vibrant and fully integrated academic, residential, and cocurricular experience is sustained by a diverse and supportive community. Located in Waterville, Maine, Colby is a global institution with students representing nearly every U.S. state and approximately 70 countries.  
  
Colby’s model provides the scale and impact of larger universities coupled with intensive learning in a community committed to scholarship and discovery, multidisciplinary approaches to integrated learning, study in the liberal arts, and leading-edge programs addressing the world’s most complex challenges. Its network of partnerships with prestigious cultural, research, medical, and business institutions extends educational and scholarly collaborations, providing students with unmatched experiences leading to postgraduate success.  
  
The College’s wide variety of programs and labs provides students and the community access to unique experiences: the Colby College Museum of Art, the finest college art museum in the country, and the Lunder Institute for American Art have made the College a nationally and internationally recognized center for art scholarship; DavisConnects prepares students for lifelong success by combining a forward-thinking liberal arts education with extensive internship, research, and global opportunities for all students regardless of their personal networks and financial circumstances; and the 350,000-square-foot Harold Alfond Athletics and Recreation Center, opened in 2020, is the most advanced and comprehensive NCAA D-III facility in the country. In fall 2021, Colby opened the Davis Institute for Artificial Intelligence, the first such institute at a liberal arts college.

About David Carpenter

David Carpenter is a distinguished lecturer at the University of Vermont's Grossman School of Business, where he leverages over two decades of extensive experience in environmental law, land use, and renewable energy to enrich the academic landscape for aspiring business professionals. Currently, he plays a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of leaders through his innovative course, "Law as a Framework for Entrepreneurial Business," designed specifically for students in the Sustainable Innovation MBA program. This 15-hour course emphasizes a hands-on approach, equipping students with practical legal tools and skills essential for navigating the complexities of modern business environments.  
  
In addition to his teaching responsibilities, David is actively engaged with Green Lantern Development, where he provides strategic counsel on renewable energy projects, underscoring his commitment to sustainable practices. His expertise encompasses a wide array of areas, including solar energy, waste management, and regulatory analysis, making him a valuable asset in the renewable energy sector. As a past Co-Chair of Renewable Energy Vermont, David remains deeply involved in industry organizations, advocating for progressive policies that address climate change and promote sustainable development.  
  
David’s multifaceted background in contract negotiation, due diligence, and mergers & acquisitions further enhances his teaching, allowing him to share real-world insights that resonate with students. By integrating his professional experiences with academic theory, he fosters a dynamic learning environment that prepares students to tackle the legal challenges they will face as future entrepreneurs in an increasingly complex and environmentally-conscious marketplace.

About La Place des Arts
-----------------------

Organisme public au service de tous les Québécois, la Société de la Place des Arts est vouée à la diffusion des arts de la scène.  
  
La Place des Arts administre cinq salles de spectacles à Montréal ainsi que l’Amphithéâtre de Lanaudière. Lieu de résidence d’organismes artistiques majeurs, la Place des Arts favorise l’accessibilité aux diverses formes d’arts de la scène et fait la promotion de la vie artistique et culturelle du Québec.  
  
La Place des Arts occupe une place primordiale sur la scène québécoise et montréalaise. Elle est non seulement aux premières loges du développement des arts de la scène d’ici et de l’ouverture du Québec à la réalité artistique mondiale, mais elle en est un des principaux acteurs. Depuis plus de quatre décennies, son parcours est éloquent, riche en événements et découvertes.  
  
Pour la réalisation de sa mission, la Société accueille, produit ou coproduit des œuvres artistiques du Québec et de l’étranger, organise des activités visant la sensibilisation et l’accroissement du public, offre des services particuliers et des équipements techniques spécialisés aux organismes artistiques et aux producteurs et, enfin, conclut des ententes de diffusion avec divers partenaires.  
  
Grâce à une présence active dans le milieu artistique et en faisant preuve d’une grande sensibilité à l’égard des besoins et attentes du public et des producteurs de spectacles, elle constitue un véritable carrefour de la vie culturelle montréalaise et québécoise.

About Cobalt
------------

Harnessing the potential of distributed ledger technology, Cobalt delivers a private peer-to-peer network that significantly reduces post-trade cost and risk for financial market participants. Legacy infrastructure is duplicative, inefficient and unfit for today’s market. A single trade creates multiple records for all parties. Cobalt’s technology leverages blockchain-derived concepts of encryption, digital signatures and consensus to deliver a single, immutable record for each trade. By creating a shared view of trade data, Cobalt frees up back and middle office resources from multiple layers of reconciliation. With no legacy infrastructure to protect, Cobalt is taking a fresh approach to post-trade technology. This is the future of financial services infrastructure: signed, sealed, delivered.

About KALW Public Radio 91.7 FM
-------------------------------

KALW 91.7 FM is a pioneering educational and community broadcast service licensed to the San Francisco Unified School District. On-air since September 1st, 1941, it is the first FM station west of the Mississippi. — a full thirty years older than NPR.  
  
KALW created the first FM broadcast training program in the country and it trained women in radio broadcasting during World War II. KALW continues this tradition with the Audio Academy, a 10-month, tuition-free journalism training program, as well as its summer podcast academy for teens and its Uncuffed radio training program inside San Quentin and Solano State Prisons.  
  
KALW has a track record of programming innovation: it was the first station in the Bay Area to air Fresh Air, This American Life, Snap Judgement and The Daily. It was also the first station to air the BBC in the Bay Area, and was for decades the BBC’s station of record in San Francisco. KALW is also the birthplace of 99 Percent Invisible and Radio Ambulante, and Snap Judgement’s Glynn Washington recorded his show’s demos at KALW’s studios. The origins of Ear Hustle can also be traced to KALW’s volunteer program at San Quentin State Prison.  
  
The station has been at the forefront of high-quality, socially minded radio from its inception. It remains deeply rooted in the Bay Area and its culture. The expansion into KALW@25thStreet in Oakland for the new DJ lineup is a testament to its dedication to all nine Bay Area counties where it broadcasts. KALW believes in creating and broadcasting stories that are social-justice minded and solutions-oriented.  
  
With its diverse leadership and staff, and the voices centered in the station’s on-air reporting, KALW is on a mission to inspire audiences and tell the human story in all its breadth and richness. About Pace Gallery
------------------

Pace is a leading international art gallery representing some of the most influential contemporary artists and estates from the past century, holding decades-long relationships with Alexander Calder, Jean Dubuffet, Barbara Hepworth, Agnes Martin, Louise Nevelson, and Mark Rothko. Pace enjoys a unique U.S. heritage spanning East and West coasts through its early support of artists central to the Abstract Expressionist and Light and Space movements.  
  
Since its founding by Arne Glimcher in 1960, Pace has developed a distinguished legacy as an artist-first gallery that mounts seminal historical and contemporary exhibitions. Under the current leadership of President and CEO Marc Glimcher, Pace continues to support its artists and share their visionary work with audiences worldwide by remaining at the forefront of innovation. Now in its seventh decade, the gallery advances its mission through a robust global program—comprising exhibitions, artist projects, public installations, institutional collaborations, performances, and interdisciplinary projects. Pace has a legacy in art bookmaking and has published over five hundred titles in close collaboration with artists, with a focus on original scholarship and on introducing new voices to the art historical canon.  
  
Today, Pace has nine locations worldwide including London, Geneva, a strong foothold in Palo Alto, and two galleries in New York—its headquarters at 540 West 25th Street, and an adjacent 8,000 sq. ft. exhibition space at 510 West 25th Street. Pace was one of the first international galleries to establish outposts in Asia, where it operates permanent gallery spaces in Hong Kong and Seoul, as well as an office and viewing room in Beijing. In 2020, Pace opened temporary exhibition spaces in East Hampton and Palm Beach, with continued programming on a seasonal basis. In fall 2021, Pace will continue to expand its European presence with the opening of a larger gallery space in London.

--------------

Poshmark is a leading social marketplace for new and secondhand style for women, men, kids, pets, home, and more. Our community of more than 80 million people across the US, Canada, Australia, and India is shaping the future of shopping to be simple, social, and sustainable.  
  
As a pioneer in social commerce, we offer a platform for sellers and shoppers to connect with each other, make additional income, find unique, one of a kind pieces, extend the life cycle of items, participate in the circular economy, and more. Leveraging social networking, real-time trends, and data-driven recommendation engines allow us to create a personalized shopping experience that empowers sellers to embark on their entrepreneurial journey and re-invent shopping for the social media generation.  
  
Since our founding in 2011, our team has grown to over 800 employees located around the world, all of whom are dedicated to our mission of putting people at the heart of commerce. In addition to our headquarters in Redwood City, California, we have offices in Vancouver, Canada, Sydney, Australia, and Chennai, India. Interested in joining Team Posh? Head to poshmark.com/careers.  
  
For more information, please visit poshmark.com, and for company news and announcements, please visit newsroom.poshmark.com. You can also find Poshmark on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, YouTube, and Snapchat.

About Life is good
------------------

One van. Two brothers. Three simple words: Life is Good.  
  
For five years, Bert and John Jacobs drove up and down the East Coast, selling their t-shirt designs on the streets and in college dorms. They slept in their van, lived on PB&J, and showered when they could. The adventure was great, but sales were, uh, lacking.  
  
In 1994, with just $78 to their names, Bert and John designed their first Life is Good t-shirt to counter the negative news—and discovered how those three simple words could inspire people to focus on the good.  
  
The brothers stumbled forward, making mistakes left and right, but the power of that one idea was just too strong to get wrong. Letters and emails started rolling in from customers who found strength, simple wisdom, or a much-needed laugh in Life is Good.  
  
This diverse, ever-growing community continues to inspire our mission: To spread the power of optimism. 25 years into the ride, we celebrate these optimists and all the ordinary, extraordinary things they love.

Nashville, Tennessee-based Bridgestone Americas, Inc. is a subsidiary of Bridgestone Corporation, a global leader providing sustainable mobility and advanced solutions. Bridgestone develops, manufactures and markets a diverse portfolio of original equipment and replacement tires, tire-centric solutions, mobility solutions and other rubber-associated and diversified products that deliver social and customer value. These best-in-class offerings are sold to consumers and fleet customers around the world under the trusted Bridgestone and Firestone brand names.  
  
With more than 50 production facilities and 55,000 employees, the Bridgestone Americas enterprise spans from Canada to Argentina. Business units of Bridgestone Americas include Bridgestone Retail Operations, the world’s largest network of company-owned retail tire and automotive service centers; Bandag, a leader in commercial tire retreading worldwide; Firestone Building Products, an industry leader in commercial roofing and building solutions; and Firestone Industrial Products, a leading provider of technologically advanced air springs for commercial and passenger vehicle applications.  
  
Across all its businesses, Bridgestone is dedicated to shaping a sustainable future. Guided by its global corporate social responsibility commitment, Our Way to Serve, the company strives to improve the way people around the world move, live, work and play in every aspect of its business.

About Inwood Academy for Leadership Charter School
--------------------------------------------------

Inwood Academy for Leadership Charter School, located at 3896 10th Ave, New York, NY, is a transformative educational institution dedicated to empowering students to become proactive leaders in their communities. Founded in 2010, the school operates on the principle that every child deserves access to a high-quality education, regardless of their family's income or zip code. With a strong focus on community engagement, character development, and college preparedness, Inwood Academy prepares its students not just for academic success, but for life beyond the classroom.  
  
Since opening its doors to its inaugural class of 110 fifth graders, Inwood Academy has evolved into a nurturing environment that supports students throughout their educational journey. The school proudly graduated its first senior class in 2018 and continues to provide robust support to alumni, ensuring they have the resources necessary to earn their college degrees or successfully enter the workforce. The commitment to inclusivity is evident in the school's admissions process, which gives preference to English Language Learners residing in the district, as well as siblings of current students.  
  
Inwood Academy for Leadership boasts a dedicated team of educators who are passionate about fostering a love for learning and leadership in their students. For those interested in the faculty, a comprehensive Inwood Academy for Leadership Charter School teachers list is available, showcasing the diverse and skilled professionals who contribute to the school's mission. By prioritizing leadership development and community involvement, Inwood Academy is not just shaping students' futures; it is cultivating the next generation of changemakers.

In addition to her writing, Natassa is also an active voice on social media, where she engages with her readers and shares insights into her creative process, further fostering a sense of connection and community among fans of her work. Her openness and approachability have endeared her to a wide audience, and her impact extends beyond the pages of her novels.  
  
Ika Natassa is a writer who has left an indelible mark on Indonesia's literary landscape, and her influence continues to grow as her work reaches new audiences around the world.
