About Spectrum Laboratories, Inc
--------------------------------

SpectrumLabs, a Repligen company, is a global leader in membrane separation technologies for the pharmaceutical, bioprocess, diagnostic and research industries. Spectrum focuses on two core technologies, Single-Use Hollow Fiber Tangential Flow Filtration and Tubular Membrane Dialysis.  
  
Spectrum’s early accomplishments include the invention of cellulosic dialysis membranes in a wide range of molecular weight cut-off’s for the gentle purification of proteins, desalting enzymes and sample preparation. Sold under the trade name Spectra/Por®, dialysis membranes and accessories lead the market with sales in more than seventy countries.  
  
In 1995, Spectrum started production of mixed cellulose ester hollow fiber filters for the purification and concentration of biopharmacuticals and diagnostic particles. Spectrum has successfully expanded this technology and market reach by introducing a wide range of hollow fiber membrane chemistries and pore sizes for ultrafiltration, nanofiltration and microfiltration. These KrosFlo® branded membrane filters and support pump systems are used in a multitude of upstream and downstream filtration applications. Spectrum further strives to advance Tangential Flow Filtration technology by developing new hollow fiber membrane chemistries. Recently Spectrum introduced a hydrophilic and low protein binding modified polyethersulfone hollow fiber membrane that provides superior flux and higher product recovery.  
  
Global Locations  
Repligen headquarters is in Waltham, Massachusetts and our manufacturing facilities are located around the world. We market our products globally through a direct commercial organization in the U.S., Europe and Asia, as well as through strategic partners in select markets.

About Tiffany Stewart

Tiffany Stewart, the wife of renowned entrepreneur and billionaire Mark Cuban, is an accomplished businesswoman and philanthropist in her own right. While being married to one of the most recognizable faces in the business world may garner attention, Stewart has carved out her own path, focusing on her career and making a difference in the lives of others.  
  
Born on January 1, 1970, in the suburbs of Indiana, Stewart embraced the Midwestern values of hard work, determination, and humility from an early age. She excelled academically and graduated with a bachelor's degree in advertising from Indiana University in 1990. Following her graduation, she moved to Dallas, Texas, and embarked on a successful career in advertising.  
  
Stewart's entrepreneurial spirit led her to become an advertising executive at the prestigious DDB Needham, a global advertising agency. Her dedication and talent quickly earned her recognition within the industry, resulting in her working with notable brands such as Dr. Pepper, American Airlines, and Procter & Gamble. Stewart's ability to develop innovative marketing strategies and build strong client relationships helped her thrive in the competitive advertising world.  
  
In 2002, Stewart's life took a significant turn when she met Mark Cuban, the maverick entrepreneur and owner of the Dallas Mavericks basketball team. The pair hit it off instantly, and their relationship blossomed. However, Stewart's down-to-earth nature and commitment to her career remained a constant amidst their whirlwind romance. It was this level-headedness that attracted Cuban, as he once described her as "our rock, someone that realizes what we want to do and helps us make it happen."  
  
While Stewart supports her husband's endeavors and often accompanies him to high-profile events, she has chosen to keep a low profile in the media. This deliberate decision has allowed her to prioritize her privacy and focus on her family and personal pursuits. Despite her preference for a quieter life, she is a constant presence at the Dallas Mavericks' games, cheering her husband and the team on from their seats.  
  
Beyond her successful career and supportive role as a wife and mother, Stewart is deeply committed to philanthropy. Together with Mark Cuban, they established the Mark Cuban Foundation, an organization dedicated to supporting various causes, including disaster relief, healthcare, and education initiatives. Stewart plays an integral part in the foundation's activities and actively contributes to its mission of creating a positive and lasting impact on communities in need.  
  
Stewart's philanthropic efforts extend beyond her involvement with the foundation. Along with Cuban, she has pledged significant donations to organizations such as the Boys and Girls Clubs of America and the Global Giving Initiative. These contributions reflect her genuine compassion for those less fortunate and her desire to create opportunities for others to thrive.  
  
In conclusion, Tiffany Stewart is not only known as Mark Cuban's wife but also as a remarkable businesswoman and philanthropist in her own right. From her successful advertising career to her dedication to making a positive impact, Stewart exemplifies the values of hard work, humility, and compassion. While choosing to maintain a more private life, her contributions in the business world and philanthropy are commendable and worthy of admiration. Tiffany Stewart continues to inspire others with her accomplishments and dedication to making the world a better place.

About SBH Sciences
------------------

SBH Sciences is an innovative preclinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on anti-cancer and anti-inflammation drug development. In its 19 years of working with over 180 biotechnology and diagnostic companies, SBH Sciences has earned a reputation for product quality, excellent service, and on-time delivery.  
  
We partner with early-stage biotechnology companies to provide incubator-model support, as well as cell-based discovery, cytokines and enzyme production, and immunological and analytical services. Our collection of 300 cytokine bioassays is the most comprehensive in the US. We are also very active in cytotoxicity testing, biomarker measurement, functional activity testing, in-vivo modeling, diagnostics, and kinase screening services. For example, we have over 350 human cancer cell lines for in-vitro oncology lead drug screening.  
Moreover, we are offering 10 biomarkers platform including fully automatic ELISA workstation, Luminex, Automatic Western Blot (PeggySue and WES), ELLA, HTRF, Alpha-Lisa, FACS, HPLC and qRT-PCR.

About Graphite Bio
------------------

Graphite Bio is a clinical-stage, next-generation gene editing company driven to discover and develop cures for a wide range of serious and life-threatening diseases. The company is pioneering a precision gene editing approach that has the potential to transform human health by achieving one of medicine’s most elusive goals: to precisely “find & replace” any gene in the genome. Graphite Bio’s UltraHDR™ gene editing platform takes CRISPR beyond cutting and harnesses the power of high-efficiency precision DNA repair, also known as homology-directed repair (HDR), to precisely correct genetic mutations, replace entire disease-causing genes with functional genes or insert new genes into predetermined, safe locations. Additionally, the company is advancing the development of novel conditioning regimens to help bring curative therapies to more patients. The company was co-founded by academic pioneers in the fields of gene editing and gene therapy, including Maria Grazia Roncarolo, M.D., and Matthew Porteus, M.D., Ph.D.

The university's emphasis on research and community engagement equips students with the skills and knowledge necessary to excel in their chosen fields. Prospective students can explore various programs and faculty expertise through the Texas Woman's University teachers list, which showcases the accomplished educators dedicated to fostering an enriching learning environment.  
  
As a public university, TWU is committed to accessibility and inclusivity, ensuring that a diverse student body can thrive in a supportive atmosphere. The university's dedication to women's education and leadership continues to resonate, making it a unique institution that not only champions academic excellence but also promotes social change. For more information on programs, admissions, and campus life, visit \[Texas Woman's University\](https://www.twu.edu).

About Adam Viet

Adam Viet brings a unique blend of expertise and passion to his role as Co-Host of The Shooters Touch Podcast, where he combines his love for basketball with his extensive background in growth and development. As the Director of Growth and Development at Professional Project Partners, Inc. (P3), Adam leverages over a decade of experience in technical recruiting, business development, and account management to create engaging content that resonates with both casual fans and industry insiders. His insights into the dynamics of Web2 and Web3 companies enrich the podcast, as he draws parallels between the evolving landscape of technology and the strategic plays on the basketball court.  
  
At The Shooters Touch Podcast, Adam and his co-host delve into the intricacies of the game, discussing everything from player performance and coaching strategies to the cultural impact of basketball. His skills in strategic planning and business intelligence allow him to analyze trends within the sport, making for thought-provoking discussions that appeal to a wide audience. Adam’s background in fitness training also informs his perspective on player conditioning and athletic performance, providing listeners with a well-rounded view of the game.  
  
Through key projects such as interviews with industry leaders and in-depth analyses of pivotal games, Adam aims to foster a community of basketball enthusiasts who appreciate the sport beyond just the surface level. His ability to connect with guests and listeners alike, combined with his professional acumen, positions The Shooters Touch Podcast as a valuable resource for anyone looking to deepen their understanding of basketball and its broader implications.

Fondée en 1972, Trévi est une entreprise québécoise spécialisée dans la conception, fabrication, vente et installation de piscines et spas. L’entreprise exploite 11 magasins corporatifs au Québec et compte 12 détaillants. Elle distribue même ses produits dans la région de Calgary et sur la côte Est américaine.  
  
Chef de file dans son domaine au Canada, ses valeurs mettent en lumière autant l’aspect humain derrière ses réalisations et relations de travail, que la qualité de ses produits et l’innovation dans sa façon d’être et de grandir. Les produits Trévi, fabriqués et adaptés pour résister au climat hivernal, sont issus des processus d’innovation les plus récents dans le domaine. L’entreprise ne cesse d'évoluer et tester les meilleurs produits et pratiques pour offrir à ses clients des produits répondant aux normes strictes de qualité qui font sa réputation.  
  
Trévi et ses franchisés emploient environ 1 600 personnes. Grâce aux efforts soutenus de ses équipes novatrices, Trévi offre une expérience client unique et détient le titre de Mieux gérée depuis plus d’une décennie.

### Frequently Asked Questions about BASIC NEO

What services does BASIC offer for Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)?

BASIC provides comprehensive administration services for Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), including plan setup, participant enrollment, claims processing, and customer support. Our team ensures compliance with IRS regulations and offers tools to help employees maximize their FSA benefits, making it easier for them to manage their healthcare expenses.

How does BASIC handle COBRA administration?

BASIC specializes in COBRA administration by managing the entire process from notification to premium collection. We ensure compliance with federal regulations, provide timely notifications to qualified beneficiaries, and handle all the necessary paperwork. Our goal is to simplify the COBRA process for employers and ensure that employees have access to their continuation of coverage options.

What is a Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) and how does BASIC support it?

A Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) is an employer-funded account that reimburses employees for qualified medical expenses. BASIC supports HRAs by providing administrative services such as plan design, claims processing, and compliance management. We work with employers to customize HRAs that meet their specific needs while ensuring that all IRS regulations are followed.

Can BASIC assist with Section 125 Plan Document Services?

Yes, BASIC offers Section 125 Plan Document Services to help employers establish and maintain compliant cafeteria plans. Our services include drafting plan documents, ensuring compliance with IRS regulations, and providing ongoing support to ensure that all aspects of the plan are properly managed. This helps employers provide flexible benefits to their employees while minimizing tax liabilities.

What industries does BASIC serve?

BASIC serves a wide range of industries, including healthcare, education, manufacturing, retail, and more. Our expertise in benefits administration and compliance allows us to tailor our services to meet the unique needs of various sectors, ensuring that organizations can effectively manage their employee benefit plans while remaining compliant with applicable regulations.

How can BASIC help employers manage Parking Reimbursement Accounts?

BASIC provides administrative services for Parking Reimbursement Accounts, helping employers set up and manage these accounts efficiently. Our services include participant enrollment, claims processing, and compliance oversight. We ensure that employers and employees can take full advantage of tax savings associated with parking expenses, making it easier to manage transportation costs.

About Dwayne Wayans

Dwayne Wayans is an acclaimed American writer and film score composer, best known for his ability to create emotionally charged music that brings stories to life on the big screen. With his unique talent for crafting melodies that resonate with audiences, Wayans has made a significant impact on the world of film scoring.  
  
Born and raised in Los Angeles, Wayans was surrounded by the vibrant and diverse music scene of the city. From a young age, he developed a deep appreciation for various genres, ranging from classical music to hip-hop and everything in between. This eclectic mix of musical influences helps him create scores that are fresh and dynamic, taking inspiration from different musical traditions and styles.  
  
Wayans' journey into the world of music began when he took up the piano at the age of six. He quickly fell in love with the instrument, spending hours practicing and exploring its capabilities. As he grew older, Wayans began experimenting with composition, using his piano skills to create his own original pieces. His natural ability to craft beautiful melodies soon caught the attention of his friends and family, who encouraged him to pursue a career in music.  
  
Following his passion, Wayans enrolled in the renowned Berklee College of Music in Boston. There, he honed his skills as a composer and studied the art of film scoring. Wayans was particularly captivated by the power of music to enhance storytelling and evoke emotions in the audience. This fascination with the marriage of music and film became the driving force behind his career.  
  
After graduating, Wayans returned to Los Angeles, eager to make his mark in the film industry. Determined to stand out, he began collaborating with independent filmmakers, offering his services as a composer for their projects. This allowed Wayans to gain valuable experience in scoring a variety of film genres, from dramas to comedies and everything in between. His ability to adapt his musical style to fit different narratives became one of his trademarks, attracting more and more filmmakers to seek his expertise.  
  
The breakthrough for Wayans came with his work on the critically acclaimed independent film "Harmony's Reflection." His hauntingly beautiful score garnered significant praise from both audiences and critics alike, cementing his reputation as a rising star in the world of film scoring. The success of "Harmony's Reflection" paved the way for Wayans to work on bigger projects, including major studio productions.  
  
One of Wayans' most notable achievements came with his collaboration on the blockbuster superhero film "Guardians of Destiny." With its sprawling landscapes and epic battles, the movie demanded a score that would match its grandeur. Wayans rose to the occasion, crafting a powerful and majestic score that perfectly complemented the on-screen action. His work on "Guardians of Destiny" not only earned him widespread recognition but also a nomination for the prestigious Golden Globe Award for Best Original Score.  
  
In addition to his work in film scoring, Wayans has also established himself as a talented writer. He has written several screenplays and is known for his ability to create compelling narratives that captivate viewers. Wayans' storytelling skills are often reflected in his musical compositions, with his scores seamlessly weaving through the plot, enhancing the emotional impact of each scene.  
  
With his unique blend of creativity, technical skill, and emotional depth, Dwayne Wayans continues to leave an indelible mark on the world of film scoring. As an American writer and composer, his work embodies the diversity and richness of the country's musical heritage. Whether he is crafting a tender love theme or an adrenaline-fueled action sequence, Wayans' music is sure to resonate with audiences for generations to come.

Kommunen består av sex tätorter där det finns bra och prisvärda villor, lägenheter och byggklara tomter. Tillsammans är vi drygt 15 200 invånare i kommunen.  
  
Det finns bra barnomsorg och skola samt hög servicenivå inom vård och omsorg.  
  
Över hela kommunen finns idrottsanläggningar, härliga marker för bär- och svampplockning, skogsbackar och stränder som lockar till besök med fikakorg och fiskespön i bagaget.
